samples.hyp: Ukuhlola izinga lokuhlolwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2 elidingekayo elibanzi ukuze kungenzeka kulawulwe ukuqhambuka kwesifo esifundeni esiyisizinda iLusaka esifundazweni saseZambia ngokubheka abantu abangakhombisi zimpawu:
Ucwaningo olulula lokumodela izibalo

Isifo esisha seCoronavirus (COVID-19), esibangelwa yi-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (SARS-CoV-2), e-Afrika sibonakala ngenani elikhulu labantu abangakhombisi izimpawu (noma abanezimpawu ezincane) abacabangwa ukuthi badlala indima ekusakazeni ukutheleleka.
Isilinganiso esinembile kanye nezinga lokutheleleka kwabantu abangabonakali zimpawu kusalokhu kungacaci.
Nokho, izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwazo kubalulekile ekulawuleni ukudluliselwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2.

Sakhe imodeli yezibalo elula ye-deterministic susceptible-exposed-infectious-removed (SEIR) ukuze sihlaziye umphumela wokuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwabantu abangenwe yi-SARS-CoV-2 kodwa abangakhombisi zimpawu ngokuhlolwa okubanzi ukuze kulawulwe ukuqhamuka kwesifo eSifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia.
Lapha sihlomise izimo ezimbili; (1) sicabanga ukuthi abantu abangabonakali izimpawu babumba u-70% wazo zonke izimo ze-COVID-19 futhi (2) abantu abangabonakali izimpawu babumba u-50% kuphela wezimbo.

Ngokuphambene, imodeli yahlolwa kuqala ngaphansi komcabango wokuthi abantu abangakhombisi izimpawu banegciwane elilinganayo nabantu abakhombisa izimpawu, bese kuthi okwesibili, futhi okungenzeka kakhulu, kucatshangwe ukuthi abantu abangakhombisi izimpawu banegciwane elingaphansi kwesigamu sabantu abakhombisa izimpawu.

Emodelini ecabanga amacala angama-70% angabonakali, izinga lokuhlola elincane eliqhubekayo lansuku zonke elingu-≥ 7911 izivivinyo/100000 zabantu belanele ukulawula ukuqhuma uma abantu abangabonakali benegciwane elingaphansi ngengxenye kuphela kuyilapho uma kucatshangwa ukuthi banegciwane elilinganayo khona-ke izinga lokuhlola elingu-≥ 10028 izivivinyo/100000 zabantu liyodingeka.

Kwabangama-50% abangabonakali izimpawu, izinga elincane lokuhlolwa kwabantu elingu-≥ 4540 ukuhlola/100000 abantu lalanele ukulawula ukuqhambuka kuleso simo esibhekene nezinga lokutheleleka kwabantu abangabonakali izimpawu uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu ababonisa izimpawu.

Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwamacala e-COVID-19, kuhlanganise nabantu abangabonakali izimpawu, ngokuhlolwa okubanzi kungasetshenziswa njengesinyathelo esingaba khona sokulawula ukusabalala kwe-SARS-CoV-2 eLusaka, eZambia, kodwa kuzofika ngentengo ephezulu.
Ukuhlolwa ngobuningi emadolobheni amakhulu njengeLusaka kungase kunciphise ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19, kodwa ngabe kuyasebenza?
Ngo-2020, amamodeli ekhompyutha abikezela ukuthi ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu kungalawulwa kangcono ngokuhlolwa okukhulu, bese kuthi bonke abathole ukuthi banezifo bahlukaniswe.
Nokho, abacwaningi bathi le ndlela ingabiza futhi ingasebenzi kahle.
Ekuqaleni kobhubhane, abantu abaningi ababetholakala bene-COVID-19 babengabonisi zimpawu zesifo kodwa babesakaza lesi sifo kwabanye.
Ezinye izifundo ziphakamise ukuthi u-50% kuya ku-80% yabantu abane-COVID-19 ababanga nabakhombisi zimpawu (asymptomatic) futhi bangaba nesibopho sokuba ngu-40% kuya ku-70% wokutheleleka okusha.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuthola nokuhlukanisa abantu abangenazo izimpawu kungasiza yini ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.
Bafuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlolwa kwe-banket, okusho ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, ngempumelelo kuthola abantu abangenaso isifo esibonakalayo.
Abacwaningi bakha imodeli yekhompyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu badlula kanjani ekubeni sengozini yokutheleleka, batheleleke, bese behlukaniswa.
Bagxile kudatha evela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyindawo yezinkampani enesikhumulo sezindiza samazwe ngamazwe esingumngcele namazwe amabili.

Ngoba izici ze-COVID-19 zazibonakala zihlukahluka ukusuka endaweni kuya kwenye, babheka izimo ezine, lapho kungaba u-50% noma u-70% wezigameko ze-COVID-19 ezazingabonakali izimpawu, futhi lezi zigameko zazifana noma zazingxenye njengalezo ezinezimpawu ekuthathelaneni.

Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi kungenzeka ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza izivivinyo ezibanzi kanye nokuhlukanisa bonke abantu abatholakala benezimpawu ezinhle, ngisho nalabo abangenazo izimpawu.
Bathi ukuze kuncishiswe inani eliphakeme lamacala ngo-90% kuzo zonke izimo, u-10% wabantu baseLusaka kudingeke ukuthi bahlolwe nsuku zonke.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina inani lezifo ezintsha ze-COVID-19 lihlala linjalo, u-22% wabantu kudingeka bahlolwe nsuku zonke.
Ngaphandle kokuthi iZambia ibeke izinyathelo eziningi zokunciphisa i-COVID-19, amacala abesabonakala ekhulayo.
Ukuhlolwa okwenziwa kubantu bonke kwehlise ngempumelelo inani lamacala e-COVID-19 ngo-90% edolobheni elincane e-Italy.
Kodwa, azikho izifundo zangaphambilini eziphakamisa ukuthi kungaba ngempumelelo edolobheni elikhulu kwenye indawo.

Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abakwenzanga ukuhlolwa okubanzi kulesi sicwaningo; kunalokho bakha imodeli ekhombisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasebenza ukunciphisa ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi kungenzeka kube kubiza kakhulu.
Baphinde bathi kungase kube ngokusebenza kangcono uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinyathelo, ezifana nokukhiya, ukulandelela oxhumana nabo, kanye nokugoma.
Abacwaningi baseZambia baphinde bagcizelela ukuthi amacala e-COVID-19 angenazimpawu abebonakala ejwayelekile kakhulu e-Afrika ngaleso sikhathi.
Ukusebenza okuphansi kwamaphuzu e-polygenic ezizweni zase-Afrika ngenxa yokuhlukahluka kofuzo kanye nezemvelo
Izibalo zabantu base-Afrika azimelelwa ngokwanele ezifundweni zofuzo kodwa zinokuhlukahluka okukhulu kofuzo futhi zibhekene nezimo ezihlukahlukene zemvelo emhlabeni wonke.

Ngoba ukuhlolwa okuhlelekile kwezibikezelo zofuzo kwakungakwenziwa ezizukulwaneni ezihlanganisa ukuhlukahluka kwe-Afrika, sabala amaphuzu obungozi be-polygenic (PRS) ezilinganisweni ezihlukahlukene e-Afrika nasezidatsheni ezivela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuze siqonde kangcono ukujwayeleka kwezifundo zofuzo.
Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuthuthuka kakhulu ngezizukulwane zokutholwa ezifanayo ngokobuhlanga kunokutholakala ezifundweni ezingahambisani ngokobuhlanga.
Phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlukahlukene ngokwezizukulwane nobuzwe, sithola ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izici kodwa kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwamaqembu.

Umehluko kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika unomthelela omkhulu ekushintshashintsheni kokunemba kwe-PRS kunokwehluka okukhulu kwezinye izigaba ezicatshangelwe phakathi kwabantu base-UK uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Uganda.

Sibale i-PRS kubantu abanesizinda sase-Afrika sisebenzisa izifundo zofuzo ezikhona ezimayelana ne-European kuphela uma kuqhathaniswa nezifundo zofuzo ezihlukahlukene ngokwesizinda; ukwanda kokuhlukahluka kukhiqize inzuzo enkulu kunazo zonke yokunemba kokugxila kwe-hemoglobin kanye nenani lamangqamuzana egazi amhlophe, okukhombisa ukwehluka okukhulu okuthathwe ezizindeni zofuzo ezaziwa ngokuthonya i-sickle cell anemia kanye nesimpendulo sokungezwani komzimba, ngokulandelanayo.

Umehluko ekunembeni kwe-PRS kuzo zonke izinhlanga zase-Afrika ezivela ezifundeni ezihlukahlukene mkhulu njengakuzo zonke izinhlanga zase-Afrika eziphuma emazweni asezwenikazi, okudinga ukuqonda okufanele.
Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela kahle izifo zofuzo kubantu abavela kuzizukulwane zase-Afrika
Abaphenyi bathi izindlela zamanje ezisetshenziselwa ukuqagela ukuthi umuntu uzothuthukisa isifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi i-database ngemuva kwalokhu kubikezela ikakhulukazi ichaza ama-gene abantu abavela e-European origin.
Isizindalwazi se-GWAS simela "Ucwaningo Lokuhlangana Kwe-Genome-Wide", futhi ososayensi bayisebenzisa ukufuna izici nezifo ngokusekelwe kumagciwane.
Eqinisweni, bangasebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ubungozi bomuntu obuzuzwe ngokuzalwa besifo noma isici.
Iningi ledatha yofuzo ku-GWAS, nokho, livela kubantu abavela kubokhokho baseYurophu.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukubona ukuthi isilinganiso abasisebenzisayo ukunquma ubungozi bezifo zofuzo besebenzisa i-GWAS sisebenza kahle kangakanani kubantu abavela kubokhokho base-Afrika.
Bafuna futhi ukubona ukuthi uma i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi isizindalwazi esihlanganisa ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lwase-Afrika oluningi, ingathuthukisa yini izibikezelo.
Ukubalwa kwaziwa ngamagama esayensi amaningi ngokuthi "i-polygenic risk score", noma i-PRS.

Basebenzisa amakhompyutha ukubala ubungozi obuqageliwe bezakhi zofuzo zabantu base-Afrika besebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzisa amarekhodi ezokwelapha abantu base-Afrika ukuhlola izici ezithile noma izifo ezingase zibangelwe izinguquko kuma-gene.

Uma besebenzisa i-European GWAS, bathola ukuthi isilinganiso sobungozi bezakhi zofuzo sasichaneke kakhulu uma abantu babe nezizukulwane zaseYurophu uma kuqhathaniswa nezizukulwane zase-Afrika ezimweni eziningi.
Bathi amazinga obungozi aphansi kakhulu phakathi kwezifunda zase-Afrika ngoba kunokwehluka okuningi phakathi kwabantu, okungahambisani nalokho esikubona kuhlobo lwaseYurophu.
Baphinde bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyakhuphuka njengoba umsuka wase-Afrika wehla.
Izakhamuzi zase-Ethiopia zazinezibikezelo ezingcono zezifo zofuzo ngoba ngokofuzo zifana kakhulu nezakhamuzi zaseYurophu.
Uma usebenzisa i-GWAS ehlukahlukene ehlanganisa abantu abanemvelaphi yase-Afrika, ukunemba kwesibikezelo kuthuthukisiwe.
Ukubikezela izifo zegazi bekunembile kakhulu.
Izifundo zangaphambilini zikhombisile ukuthi i-PRS iphansi kubantu base-Afrika, okusho ukuthi i-database ye-GWAS ibikezela ubungozi obuphansi bezifo zofuzo kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Kodwa siyazi ukuthi lokhu akulona iqiniso ngempela.

Lolu cwaningo luchaza ukuthi lawa maphuzu aphansi obungozi bezifo zofuzo kungenxa yokuthi izakhi zofuzo zase-Afrika azimelelwe kahle kudathabheyisi ye-GWAS, ngakho amanani e-PRS akhona awasizi ngempela ukubikezela izifo zofuzo e-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi kungaba ngcono ukusebenzisa isizindalwazi esihlukahlukene esihlanganisa ulwazi lwezofuzo oluvela kubantu abavela kwinzalo yase-Afrika.
Ngakho-ke, umsebenzi owengeziwe uyadingeka ukuze kuhlukaniswe i-GWAS ukuze kufakwe ubuzwe base-Afrika ukuze sikwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile ubungozi bezifo zofuzo kubantu base-Afrika.
Ababhali balolu cwaningo babebavela e-Afrika, e-USA nase-UK.
Ukuhlolwa Kokuhlolwa Ngokubona Nokuhlolwa Kwamangqamuzana Ekugwemeni I-Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia kanye Nomdlavuza Womlomo Wesibeletho eNamibia
Abesifazane abalinganiselwa ku-851 340 eNamibia basengozini yokutheleleka ngegciwane le-human papilloma (HPV) elingadala umdlavuza wesibeletho.
Ukuskena ngeso lokhozi nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kufakazelwe ukuthi kuyasebenza kakhulu.
Nokho, idatha ehlotshaniswa nomthelela wezinhlelo zokuhlolwa komdlavuza wesibeletho iyashoda.
Lolu cwaningo luhlolisise ukuhlolwa kokubona kanye ne-cytology ekuvinjelweni kwe-cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) kanye nomdlavuza wesibeletho eNamibia.
Okutholakele kukhombisile ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis kanye ne-atypia basengozini eyandisiwe yokuthola imiphumela emihle ye-VIA.
Abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi abane-HIV banamathuba amaningi okutholakala ne-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).
Inqubo ye-VIA ibonakala iyasebenza ekuskeneni, nakuba i-colposcopy ekuqapheleni isiguli esilandela emuva esimeni saseNamibia kufanele ibuyekezwe futhi isetshenziswe nemiphumela ye-HR-HPV emihle.
Kunconywa izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kubantu abaneminyaka ehlukene kanye nezizinda ezihlukene zezingozi (isb. abane-HIV, isifo sokuzivikela komzimba).

Ukutholwa kokuhlolwa kungathuthukiswa ngokuqhubekayo ngezinyathelo ezamukela imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yokuxilonga yangaphambilini, izinhloso zezempilo zabesifazane, ulwazi olusesikhathini kanye nokusebenza okuhambisana nesimo sikazwelonke.
Abesifazane baseNamibia abasengozini yomdlavuza wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi baphathwe kusenesikhathi.
Imivivinyo eminingi ingakhombisa ubungozi besifazane bokuthola umdlavuza wesibeletho, kodwa ukuhlolwa okuvamile eNamibia akuhlali kusebenzisa le mivivinyo.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuthola izimpawu zokuxwayisa kusenesikhathi, okungavimbela abesifazane ekuthuthukiseni lesi sifo esibulalayo.
Umdlavuza wesibeletho (umdlavuza wengxenye engezansi yesibeletho) ubangela ukufa okuningi phakathi kwabesifazane emhlabeni wonke.
Enye yezimbangela ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza wesibeletho i-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
I-HPV yisifo esilimaza amaseli esibeletho, sakha amanxeba abizwa ngokuthi ama-lesion, angagcina eseba ngumdlavuza.
Yize ikhona i-vaccine yokuvimbela i-HPV, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganisa neNamibia, abakwazi ukufinyelela kuyo.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola igciwane noma izilonda elizibangela kubaluleke kakhulu kwabesifazane laba, njengoba kuyindlela engcono kakhulu yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi izibhedlela ngakho-ke zidinga iziqondiso ezifanele nolwazi mayelana nezivivinyo ezihamba phambili okufanele zisetshenziswe.
Banezela ukuthi abasebenzi bezokwelapha baphinde badinge ulwazi olunzulu ngendlela izinto ezifana nobudala noma impilo ethinta ngayo ubungozi besifazane bokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Bahlolisise ukuthi izindlela ezithile zokuhlola ezivamile (ezibizwa ngokuthi izindlela zokuhlola) zazisebenza kahle kangakanani ekutholeni i-HPV kanye nezilonda.
Baphinde babe nentshisekelo yokuhlola izindlela zokuhlola, isibonelo ukuqoqa amaseli esibelethweni ukuze babheke umonakalo uma kuqhathaniswa nokubheka izilonda kuphela.
Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ngabe umehluko phakathi kwabesifazane, njengeminyaka yabo, noma ukuthi ngabe babenezinye izifo ezifana ne-HIV, kushintsha amathuba abo okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Ukwazi lolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nezikhungo zezempilo ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ngokuphumelela okukhulu.
Abacwaningi babheka amarekhodi eziguli zabesifazane abayi-214 ababekade behlolwe futhi belashwa nge-HPV, izilonda, kanye nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho esibhedlela eWindhoek, eNamibia.
Bagxile ikakhulukazi kumdlavuza wesibeletho osesigabeni sokuqala, okuyisikhathi lapho lesi sifo singaphathwa kalula futhi ngempumelelo.
Baqoqe futhi ulwazi mayelana nobudala bowesifazane ngamunye, kanye nempilo yakhe jikelele.

Ngokubuyekeza la marekhodi, bathola ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola ezahlukene zivame ukuhlinzeka abasebenzi bezokwelapha ngolwazi oluhlukile, futhi zingase zibe usizo olukhulu ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuba i-HPV ithuthukile yaba umdlavuza.
Isifo somdlavuza, ngokwesibonelo, sasivame ukutholakala ngokuhlanganisa nokuhlola amaseli esibeletho.
Nokho, izilonda zingatholakala kaningi ngokuhlola ngamehlo, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi "ukuhlola ngamehlo nge-acetic acid" (VIA).
Inzuzo yale ndlela ukuthi ivumela odokotela ukuthola izilonda ngokushesha nangokushibhile.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi kusebenzisa imishini yezokwelapha eyisisekelo esivele isetshenziswa ekuhlolweni kwezifo zabesifazane, njengokuthi i-speculum (ithuluzi lensimbi elisetshenziselwa ukubheka ngaphakathi kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane).
Baphinde bathola ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukuhlinzeka odokotela ngemininingwane eyengeziwe mayelana nengozi yomfazi yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi uma kuhlolwa kaningi.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abane-HIV, babenomkhuba omkhulu wokutholakala benezifo zomdlavuza, ngakho ukubahlola njalo kungaba kubaluleke kakhulu.
Abacwaningi baphinde bathi bambalwa kakhulu abesifazane abahlolwe i-HPV (ngaphambi kokufuna izilonda) yize ukuhlolwa kukhona.
Ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola lesi sifo ngokushesha nakakhulu.

Sekukonke, bathi imiphumela yabo ibonise ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi uhlelo lwezempilo eNamibia luhlelele isu lokuvimbela i-HPV nomdlavuza wesibeletho ngokucophelela okukhulu, kusetshenziswa izindlela zokuhlola ezishibhile nezisebenzayo ukuthola lezi zifo ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka.
Ucwaningo lwaluwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi abavela eNamibia naseNingizimu Afrika.
Inzuzo yokwelashwa ekuthelelweni i-HBV/HIV uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthelelweni i-HBV kuphela eqenjini laseNingizimu Afrika

Siphokophele izinhloso zamazwe ngamazwe zokususwa kwegciwane le-hepatitis B (HBV), sihlosile ukuchaza abantu abane-HBV monoinfection uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HBV/HIV coinfection, ukuhlola umthelela wokwelashwa nokuhola ukuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha.
Sibika idatha yokubuka eqoqweni eliwela izigaba lomhlaba wangempela labantu abadala abangu-115 abane-hepatitis B engapheli (CHB), esibhedlela saseyunivesithi eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukutheleleka kwe-HIV bekukhona kubantu abangama-39 (34%).
Sirekhode idatha yesigaba sokuhlola esiphambanayo yezibalo zabantu, yezokwelapha kanye neyokuhlola elebhu.

Uma kuqhathaniswa nalabo abane-co-infection ye-HIV, abantu abadala abanegciwane le-HBV kuphela bebenamathuba amancane okuba yi-HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), amathuba amancane okuthi bahlolwe nge-elastography (p<0.0001), kanye namathuba amancane okuba kusekelwe ekwelashweni nge-antiviral (p<0.0001); bebenamathuba amaningi okuba ne-HBV viraemia etholakalayo (p=0.04), namathuba amaningi okuba nezimpawu zesifo sezinso okuhlanganisa i-thrombocytopaenia ephakathi/eqinile (p=0.007), i-bilirubin ekhuphukile (p=0.004), kanye nesilinganiso se-APRI esikhuphukile (p=0.02).
Izimo ezintathu ze-hepatocellular carcinoma zonke zavela ku-HBV monoinfection.

Idatha yethu ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV monoinfection bangase babe nenkathazo uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, kugcizelelwa ukungalingani okuhlelekile okungenzeka ekudluliseleni, ekubhekeni nasekwelapheni.
Abacwaningi banikeza imihlahlandlela yokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa kwe-hepatitis B.

Ocwaningweni lwakamuva, abacwaningi bakwazile ukuveza ukuthi ukutheleleka kokubili nge-hepatitis B (HBV) kanye ne-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) kungase kunikeze inzuzo yokwelashwa uma kuqhathaniswa nokutheleleka nge-HBV kuphela.
ENingizimu Afrika, ukutheleleka okungapheli kokubili i-HBV ne-HIV kuyinkinga enkulu.
Odokotela badinga ukuqonda ukuthi le mithi kanye namagciwane asetshenziselwa ukwelapha axhumana kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuxilonga kangcono nokunakekela iziguli.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokwelashwa ezigulini ezazine-HBV kuphela, neziguli ezazine-HBV kanye ne-HIV.
Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi baqasha iziguli ezingu-115 ezikhulile ezinegciwane le-hepatitis B elingamahlalakhona (CHB).
Baqashwa esibhedlela saseTygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Abanye abaguli babene-HIV (39) kanti abanye babesuleleke nge-HBV kuphela.
Abacwaningi babheke uhlanga, iminyaka nobulili, futhi benza izivivinyo ezahlukene ezokwelapha nezaselebhu.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezine-HBV kuphela kungenzeka zingatholakali kunoma yiluphi uhlobo lokwelashwa nge-antiviral, zibonisa izimpawu zemvelo zesifo sesibindi (ngoba i-HBV yigciwane elingabangela isifo sesibindi esibi).

Abacwaningi bakwazile ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela babenesimo esinzima uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV kanye ne-HBV, njengoba iziguli ezinegciwane zombili kungenzeka ukuthi zazithola ukwelashwa kwe-antiviral ye-HIV, okuphinde kunikeze inzuzo ethile ekulweni nokutheleleka kwe-HBV.

Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo igqamisa umthelela ongaba khona wokuhlukahluka phakathi kwezinketho zokudlulisela, ukuqapha kanye nokwelapha i-HBV uma kuqhathaniswa nokutheleleka ngasikhathi sinye nge-HIV ne-HBV, okuthanda labo abatheleleke kokubili i-HIV ne-HBV.
Abacwaningi bagcizelele ukuthi kumele sithuthukise futhi sinikeze insizakalo ephephile futhi elinganayo ezigulini ezithelelekile nge-HBV kuphela.
Omunye umkhawulo walesi sifundo usayizi omncane wabantu obekhethekile ezweni elilodwa kuphela kanye nezinhlelo zabo zesibhedlela.
Ezinye, mhlawumbe izilungiselelo zesibhedlela ezithuthukile zingase zibonise umbono ohlukile uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okutholakele kulesi sifundo.
Kudingeka ukuthi kwenziwe izifundo eziningi ukuze kuhlonzwe ngempela umehluko otholakele kulolu cwaningo.
Leli phepha libonise amandla okubambisana, lapho abacwaningi besebenza kule phrojekthi bevela eNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom.
Ngokusebenzisa isibalo sabaguli baseNingizimu Afrika kulesi sifundo, kubalulekile engxenyeni yesibalo sabantu base-Afrika.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwelashwa ezingcono kulabo abahlushwa yi-HBV, i-HIV noma kokubili.
Ukuhlolwa Kwethonya Lokungaphephile Ezenzweni Zokuzibandakanya Kwabesifazane Kumasipala Wendawo Yase-SHIRORO Esifundazweni SaseNiger

Ucwaningo lolu luhlolisise umthelela wokungaphephile emisebenzini yobungcweti yabesifazane eShiroro Local Government Area yaseNiger State, kugxilwe ikakhulukazi ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuncika kwezimali kwabesifazane, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yobungcweti evame phakathi kwabo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungaphephile emizamweni yabo yobungcweti.
Isampula yabesifazane abangu-377 yahlolisiswa, okuholele ekutholakaleni ukuthi abesifazane baseShiroro banamandla amakhulu okuzisebenzela futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, bavame ukuzibandakanya kuma-SME.

Ucwaningo luphinde lwathola ukuthi yize ukungaqiniseki kunephutha elibi emisebenzini yabesifazane yokuzibandakanya kwezohwebo ngendlela yokulahlekelwa noma ukwehla kwemali phakathi kwezinye izinto, inani labesifazane abahwebayo alizange libhekane nokwehla okukhulu.

Ucwaningo luncome ukuthi kudalwe izinhlelo ezisimeme zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zezezimali, futhi izinhlangano zamaphoyisa omphakathi kufanele nazo zidaliwe futhi ziqiniswe ukuze zilwe nokungaphephi endaweni yocwaningo.
Abesifazane abahweba eNiger badinga ukuvikeleka okwengeziwe

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abahamba phambili kwezamabhizinisi eNiger banamakhono amakhulu okuba osomabhizinisi futhi bazimele kwezezimali, kodwa ukuphepha eziphonsweni zobugebengu kuyinkinga.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi baphephile kanjani abesifazane abaphethe amabhizinisi eShiroro Local Government Area eNiger State, nokuthi lokhu kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi abo nokuzimela kwezezimali.
Baxoxisane nabesifazane abangu-377 kule ndawo mayelana nezinselelo ababhekana nazo ngokuphathelene nemisebenzi yabo yokuzibandakanya kwezohwebo, ukuncika kwezezimali kanye nokungaqiniseki.
Babika ukuthi u-43% wabesifazane bathi ababethembeli emadodeni ngemali, kanti u-32% bathi banabanye abantu abathembele kubo ngemali.
Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi u-85% wabesifazane babezenzela imali emabhizinisini ahlukene, kanti bambalwa kuphela abathi bathembele emiholweni.
Cishe u-56% benza imali ngokulima, kanti u-79% benza imali ngokuhweba.
Cishe oyedwa kwabahlanu besifazane uthole imali ngokuluka izinwele, ukuthunga, ukuluka noma ukwenza umsebenzi wokuwasha.
Iningi labesifazane (91%) litshele abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athintekile ngenxa yokwesaba kwabo ukuhlaselwa yizigebengu nezaphuli-mthetho.
Balahlekelwa imali ngisho nabayeni babo kulezi zihlaselo, kwesinye isikhathi kubaphoqa ukuthi banakekele izingane zabo bodwa.
Abesifazane baphinde bathi abanalwazi olwaneleyo nemali yokwandisa amabhizinisi abo.
Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwaleyo mibandela, abesifazane baseNiger baqhubeka benza kahle kakhulu emabhizinisini abo.
Bathi iShiroro yayinamaqembu abantu abavela ezizweni ezahlukene nezinkolo ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kwakulungele ibhizinisi.
Lolu cwaningo luphonsela inselelo okutholwe abanye abacwaningi ababike ukuthi abesifazane banempumelelo encane kwezebhizinisi ngenxa yokuba abaphethe ekhaya.
Kunalokho, laba bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane abahwebayo kule ndawo yaseNiger ithinteka kakhulu usongo lokuhlaselwa yizigebengu namasela.
Abacwaningi batusa ukuthi bonke ababambiqhaza kufanele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingase zibe nzima ukuphumelela ebhizinisini.
Isibonelo, abesifazane eNiger kufanele bathole ukufinyelela okwengeziwe kwezimali, amapulazi kanye nokuphepha.
Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi abesifazane abasebhizinisini bangakha amaqembu azobasiza ukulwa nezigelekeqe namaqola.

Ukugxiliswa kwe-Serum yomama kwe-Selenium, i-Copper ne-Zinc ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa kuhlotshaniswa nobungozi bokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngokuzumayo: Ucwaningo lwecala lokulawula oluvela eMalawi.
Ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesonto lama-37 eliphelele.
Ucwaningo lwenziwa ukuhlola ukuhlobana kokugxila kwe-serum yomama kwe-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc, kanye nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.
Kwakukhona abesifazane abangu-181 kulolu cwaningo lwe-nested case-control, abangu-90/181 (49.7%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esiphelele kanye nabangu-91/181 (50.3%) abakhulelwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Inani elijwayelekile le-serum concentration ye-selenium lalingu-77.0; SD 19.4µg/L, ithusi lalingu-2.50; SD 0.52 mg/L nezinki lalingu-0.77; SD 0.20 mg/L ngamareferensi amanani angu-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye no-0.59-1.11 mg/L, ngokulandelana.
Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi bekungekho ukusweleka kwe-selenium, ne-zinc; kanye nokwanda okuphezulu kwe-serum ye-copper ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwahlotshaniswa nokwanda kwamazinga e-serum yomama ye-copper ne-zinc.
Ukugxila kwe-zinc, ithusi, kanye ne-selenium okuhlotshaniswa nokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokuzalwa.

Abacwaningi bathole ukugxila okuphezulu kwe-micronutrients i-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc, kwabesifazane ababelethwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa basengazi noma lokhu kugxila okuphezulu kuvela ekudleni abakudlayo.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka uma owesifazane ezala ngaphambi kokuba aqede amasonto angu-37 ekhulelwe.
Ukuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela emibi yezempilo enganeni kusukela ekukhubazekeni kokuzalwa kuya ekufeni.
Kungenzeka kube nezimbangela eziningi zokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa indima yokuba khona okukhulu kwezakhamzimba ezincane ezitholakala ekudleni nasemvelweni ayaziwa kahle.
Lezi zinhlanganisela zamavithamini amancane zibalulekile ekuthuthukiseni ingane, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani uma ziningi kakhulu.

Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babehlose ukukala amanani e-selenium, i-copper, ne-zinc kwabesifazane ababeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bese bethola amathuba okuthi ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangelwa amanani aphezulu awo wonke ama-micronutrient afundwayo.
Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kubesifazane abayi-181 ngemuva nje kokubeletha ezibhedlela ezimbili eLilongwe, inhlokodolobha yaseMalawi, phakathi kukaJuni 2016 noMashi 2017.
Bathumele amasampula egazi elebhu eNorway lapho bakhipha khona i-serum, uhlobo oluhlanzekile lwegazi, futhi balinganisa amanani e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.
Cishe ingxenye yesigamu yabesifazane abayi-181 ocwaningweni baba nokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi abacwaningi bathole amanani aphakeme kakhulu e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.

Bese belungisa izibalo zabo ukuze zibheke ezinye izici eziningi ezifana neminyaka, impilo ejwayelekile, nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze bakhiphe imiphumela ecatshangelwayo yokudla okunamavithamini amaningi ekubangeleni ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Baphethe ngokuthi amanani amakhulu e-selenium ne-copper awazange adlale indima ebalulekile ekubangeleni ukuzalwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa ukuthi amanani aphezulu e-zinc akhuphula ingozi yokuzalwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi ngokuphindwe izikhathi eziyisithupha.
Inani elikhulu lethusi nokho laliyinkinga kubacwaningi, ngenxa yemiphumela eyaziwayo enobuthi.

Ukuba nabesifazane abangu-181 kuphela ababamba iqhaza ocwaningweni kwanciphisa ikhono labacwaningi lokuthola kahle izingozi ezihambisana namazinga aphezulu e-selenium, njengoba inani elifanele lababambiqhaza lingu-600.
Izindlela zokudla zansuku zonke zababambiqhaza azizange ziphenywe ukuthola imithombo engaba khona yezakhi ezintathu ezincane, futhi i-Body Mass Index (BMI) yabo ayizange iqoshwe.
Lolu ucwaningo lokuqala lohlobo lwalo lokulinganisa imiphumela ye-selenium, ithusi kanye ne-zinc kwabesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.

I-Afrika inamazinga aphezulu kakhulu okubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngaphezu kuka-18% uma kuqhathaniswa namazwe aseNtshonalanga angu-5%, ngakho ososayensi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ukudla kudlala indima yini.
Ukuziphatha Kwezokubuya Ekhaya, Ukuthembeka Kwendawo kanye Nobunikazi Bendawo ye-Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) eKenya
Izilwane zibonisa izindlela ezihlukile zesikhala nesikhathi ezithuthukisa ukusinda kwazo.
Ukuqonda lezo zindlela zokuziphatha kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela nokuphatha ngempumelelo ikakhulukazi izinhlobo ezisengozini.

Kulesi sifundo, senza izivivinyo zokuhlola ukuthi i-Pancake tortoise inamandla yini okubuyela ekhaya uma idlulisiwe futhi siphinde saphenya ngokwethembeka kwesiza kanye nobuzwe balesi sizukulwane ezindaweni zemvelo e-Kitui County, e-Kenya.

Ukuziphatha kwezinyamazane eziyi-39 ezihlala emifantwini yamadwala ehlukaniswe ngokwendawo eyi-12 kwafundwa kusukela ngoJulayi 2020 kuya kuJuni 2022 ngokulandelela umsakazo, ukubamba izithombe zekhamera kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuhlolwa kwezinga leqembu kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-ad libitum.
Amathole ayishumi nane afakelwa izidlulisamabhizinisi omsakazo futhi adluliselwa emifantwini ehlukile kude nemifantu yabo yasekhaya futhi ukuhamba kwawo nokuziphatha kwawo kwagadiwa.

Ngaphandle kwezinzalabantu ezimbili kuphela ezazijwayele kahle izikhala ezintsha zokuhanjiswa, wonke amanye ama-tortoise azama ukubuyela ekhaya, kanti u-46.15% wabo wabuyela ezikhala zabo zasekhaya ngokunembile futhi u-15.38% nawo wafinyelela ezindaweni okukholelwa ukuthi zingaphakathi kobubanzi basekhaya.
Ukubuya ngempumelelo ngaphandle kokungabaza kunikeza ubufakazi bokuthembeka okuqinile kwendawo kulolu hlobo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokuhlala kwezikhala zamaxoxo kukhombisile ukuthi bekungekho mehluko obalulekile wezibalo phakathi kwezinombolo zamaxoxo ekuqaleni ezikhona ezikhala kanye nenani elijwayelekile elikhona phezu kwezinsuku zokusampula eziyi-162 (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), okusekela ngokuqinile ukwethembeka kwendawo kulezi zinhlobo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imicimbi yokuthwebula izithombe ngezinkamera kanye nokusampula ad libitum nakho kufakazele ukuthi izimfene zePancake zinendawo ezizivikela lapho abesilisa bezivikela ngolaka ezindaweni zabo kwabanye abesilisa abangena.
Amatholeka epancake alahlekile anekhono eliyinqaba lokuthi 'athole ikhaya'

Abacwaningi benza ukutholakala okumangazayo ngenkathi becwaninga ukuziphatha kwama-pancake tortoises aseMpumalanga Afrika (Malacochersus tornieri): izilwane ziyakwazi ukuthola indlela yazo yokubuyela ekhaya ngemuva kokuhanjiswa amabanga amade.
Ukuqonda ukuthi benza kanjani futhi kungani benza lokhu kungabaluleka ekuvikelweni kwezilwane ezihuquzelayo ezingavamile.
Ukuziphatha kokuthola ikhaya okuboniswa yilezi ngungumbane kubizwa ngokuthi "ukubuya ekhaya", futhi nezinye izilwane eziningi ziyakwazi ukukwenza lokho.
Ukuze bakwazi ukubuyela ezindaweni ezithile kuvumela izilwane ukuthi zibuyisele ukudla, abalingani, kanye nendawo yokuhlala, okuthuthukisa amathuba abo okusinda nokuzala.

Yize ukuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya sekufundwe emathuthwini asolwandle nasemanzini ahlanzekile, abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi sisazi kancane kakhulu ngokubuyela ekhaya emafutheni (okungafana namathuthwane emhlabeni).
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ngokuziphatha kwezingulube zepanekuku endaweni yazo yemvelo emadwaleni aseKenya.
Bafunda izilwane njengoba zihamba futhi zidla, futhi nalapho ziya kuphumula emifantwini, noma ezikhawini edwaleni.
Abacwaningi babebuka amaqembu ama-pancake tortoises cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi babeka amakhamera ukuze aqophe amavidiyo ezilwane ngesikhathi bengabhekile.
Baphinde banamathisela izithumeli zomsakazo kuma-tortoise angu-14.
Lezi amadivayisi amancane avumela abacwaningi ukuthi balandele ukunyakaza kwezilwane, futhi baqaphe lapho zichitha khona isikhathi sazo phakathi nosuku nobusuku.
Abacwaningi base bethutha ezinye zalezi zifudu ezilandelwayo baziyisa endaweni entsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuzicwaninga kalula.
Kodwa-ke, ngokumangala kwabacwaningi, izimfudu ezimbili zaqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zazo zokuqala, phakathi kuka-1 no-2.5 km ukusuka lapho zazihanjiswe khona.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi abacwaningi benquma ukuzama ukuhambisa izilwane eziningi kude namakhaya azo, ukuze babone ukuthi zizokhombisa ukuziphatha okufanayo kokubuya ekhaya.

Okuthakazelisayo, cishe ingxenye yesigamu yamagongqongqo ikwazile ukuthola indlela yokubuyela emifantwini efanayo ababehlala kuyo ngaphambi kokuthuthelwa, ngokuvamile bahamba ibanga elingaphezu kuka-1.5 km ukufika lapho.
Elinye u-15% labo baphumelele ukubuyela endaweni ejwayelekile, kodwa abakwazanga ukuthola igebe abathathwe kulo ekuqaleni.
Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi izindawo ezihlukahlukene ngokuvamile zinezinga elifanayo lezifudu eziphumula kuzo, okusikisela ukuthi izifudu zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo ukuphumula.
Ividiyo evela kumakhamera iphinde yabonisa ukuthi ongwenya besilisa babengabavikeli bendawo, okusho ukuthi babeyolwa namanye amaduna azama ukungena endaweni yabo noma emifantwini.

Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kungokokuqala ukuthi kubonwe ukuziphatha kokubuya ekhaya kuma-pancake tortoises, futhi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zithanda ukuhlala nokuphumula ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zingakwenza.
Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi izimfudu zazitholaphi indlela yazo yokubuyela ekhaya, ngakho-ke ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli phuzu elibalulekile.
Ngoba izilwane ngezinye izikhathi zidinga ukudluliselwa ezindaweni ezintsha ukuze zigcinwe, lolu lwazi luzosiza abalondolozi bemvelo ukugcina izimfudu ziphephile endaweni yazo entsha.
Ucwaningo lwaluwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi abavela eKenya naseChina, futhi lungeza olwazini lwethu ngesenzo sokubuya ekhaya emafutheni nakwezinye izilwane.
I-Plasma Pharmacokinetics ye-High-Dose Oral uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Intravenous Rifampicin ezigulini ezine-Tuberculous Meningitis:
Uhlolo Olulawulwayo Olungahleliwe
Imithamo ephezulu ye-rifampicin efakwa emithanjeni ingathuthukisa imiphumela ku-tuberculous meningitis kodwa ayisebenzi ezindaweni ezinokulayisha okuphezulu.

Sasicabanga ukuthi ukuvezwa kwe-plasma rifampicin kuzofana phakathi kokuphathwa ngomlomo kwe-35 mg/kg yesisindo somzimba kanye nokuphathwa nge-intravenous kwe-20 mg/kg, okuphakanyiswe ukuhlolwa kokusebenza kwe-tuberculous meningitis.

Senze ucwaningo lwe-pharmacokinetics lweqembu elihambisanayo elikhethwe ngokungahleliwe olufakwe ngaphakathi kovivinyo lwezokwelapha lokwelashwa okwandisiwe kwemithi yokulwa namagciwane e-tuberculous meningitis.
Ababambiqhaza abane-HIV abane-tuberculous meningitis baqoqwa ezibhedlela zaseNingizimu Afrika futhi bahlukaniswa ngokungahleliwe kwelinye lamaqembu amathathu okuthola umthamo we-rifampicin:
ejwayelekile (ukuphathwa ngomlomo 10 mg/kg), umthamo ophakeme (ukuphathwa ngomlomo 35 mg/kg), kanye nokuphathwa emithanjeni (20 mg/kg).
Isampula elinzulu le-pharmacokinetics lenziwa ngosuku lwesithathu.
Idatha ichazwe kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziya okungahlangene, futhi ukuvezwa kwaqhathaniswa ngezilinganiso eziphakathi kwejiyomethri (GMRs).
Ababambiqhaza abangamashumi amane nesithupha benza isampula yokuhlola i-pharmacokinetic (umthamo ojwayelekile, n = 17; umthamo ophakeme womlomo, n = 15; i-intravenous, n = 14).
Inani eliphakathi le-CD4 kwakungu-130 amaseli/mm3 (ububanzi bamaphesenti amaphakathi [IQR], 66 kuya ku-253 amaseli/mm3).

Indawo emaphakathi ye-rifampicin ngaphansi kwejika lesikhathi sokugxila kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-24 h (AUC0–24) yayingu-42.9mg · h/ml (95% izinga lokuzethemba [CI], 24.5 kuya ku-75.0mg · h/ml) kumthamo ojwayelekile, 295.2mg · h/ml (95% CI, 189.9 kuya ku-458.8mg · h/ml) kumthamo ophakeme womlomo, kanye no-206.5mg · h/ml (95% CI, 154.6 kuya ku-275.8mg · h/ml) ekuphathweni ngomjovo.

I-rifampicin AUC0–24 GMR yayingu-1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 kuya ku-2.21) kanti inani eliphezulu lomuthi egazini (Cmax) GMR yayingu-0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 kuya ku-1.23) ekuphakanyisweni komthamo omkhulu ngomlomo maqondana nomjovo wangaphakathi.
I-plasma rifampicin AUC0–24 yayiphezulu ngemuva komthamo womlomo ongu-35-mg/kg kunokuphathwa ngomthambo ngomthamo ongu-20-mg/kg ezinsukwini zokuqala zokwelashwa kwesifo sofuba (TB).
Okutholakele kusekela ukusetshenziswa komthamo womlomo we-rifampicin ezivivinyweni zesikhathi esizayo ze-tuberculous meningitis.
Amaphilisi anomthamo omkhulu angahlolwa ezigulini ze-HIV ezine-TB meningitis.
Abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi kufanelekile ukuqala ukuhlola ukuthi ngabe umthamo ophakeme womuthi i-rifampicin ungabasindisa yini iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis.
Kufika kwabangu-3 kwabangu-5 ezigulini ze-HIV eziphinde zithole i-tuberculosis meningitis ziyafa ngenxa yale nkinga, ehlasela uhlelo lwezinzwa.
Abasindile ngokuvamile basala nomonakalo unomphela ohlelweni lwabo lwezinzwa oluphakathi kanye nezinzwa ezibalulekile ezisuka ebuchosheni.
Lokhu kungathinta imizwa yabo nokunyakaza kwabo.
Abanye abaguli baneziyezi noma izifo zokuqina kwegazi, noma izingxenye zobuso noma zomzimba wabo ziyakhubazeka.
I-Rifampicin, umuthi onamandla wamakhemikhali asetshenziswa ngokumelene nesifo sofuba, ngokuvamile unikezwa njengekhasule ukuze kuzanywe ukubulala amagciwane abanga i-tuberculosis meningitis.
Iziguli ezigula kakhulu zivame ukuthola amaphilisi kunzima ukuwagwinya.
I-Rifampicin ingaphinde inikwe ngomjovo (emithanjeni) ngendlela ewuketshezi.
Kufakwa inaliti emithanjeni yegazi yesiguli ukuze uketshezi lukhululwe emzimbeni.
Azikho izivivinyo ezisake zenziwa ukuze kutholakale ukuthi umzimba wesiguli uthatha kanjani umuthi uma le ndlela isetshenziswa.
Ukwelashwa ngomjovo we-intravenous kudinga imishini eminingi, ukuhlala esibhedlela kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo abaqeqeshiwe abakwazi ukufaka inaliti ye-intravenous ngendlela efanele.
Ngakho-ke akuyona inketho edingekayo ezindaweni zomhlaba ezinesizakhamuzi esinganele.
Odokotela sebevele bazi ukuthi i-rifampicin ayingeni kahle emanzini asengqondweni, umgogodleni kanye nekhanda, okuyilapho amagciwane angacasha khona.
Yingakho kudingeka imithamo ephezulu (amanani) ukuze kubulawe ngempumelelo wonke amagciwane emzimbeni wesiguli.
Kodwa abacwaningi bebengaqiniseki ukuthi umthamo ophakeme ungaba uphumelele futhi uphephe kangakanani.

Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabase-United Kingdom babefuna ukuthola, besebenzisa inani elincane leziguli, ukuthi kuphephile yini ukunikeza imithamo ephezulu yerifampicin njengamakhapusi noma ngomjovo, nokuthi izizimba zabo zizoyithatha kanjani inguqulo ngayinye.
Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu ngaphambi kokuba abanye abacwaningi baqale izivivinyo ezinkulu, noma ukuhlolwa, lapho behlela ukunikeza iziguli eziningi izilinganiso eziphezulu ze-rifampicin.
Omunye wezinhlobo ezintathu zokwelashwa nge-rifampicin wanikezwa iziguli ezingama-46 zaseNingizimu Afrika ezine-HIV ezine-meningitis ye-tuberculosis.
Owokuqala kwakuwukwelashwa okujwayelekile kwamakhasimende okwamanje anikezwa iziguli, okuphelele ku-10mg ye-rifampicin ngekhilogremu ngayinye isisindo sesiguli.
Elinye iqembu lathola amakhaphuli omthamo ophakeme wamamiligremu angama-35 ngekhilogramu yesisindo sesiguli.
Iqembu lesithathu lathola amagremu angama-20 ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu ngentambo emithanjeni.
Izampula zegazi zathathwa ezigulini ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Abacwaningi base belinganisa ukuthi mangaki ama-rifampicin ayekhona ku-plasma yegazi labo (ingxenye ewuketshezi yegazi).
Kutholakale i-rifampicin eningi emizimbeni yeziguli ezithole amaphilisi anedosi ephezulu kunalabo abathole ukwelashwa ngomjovo noma idosi ejwayelekile.
Ukugxila kwalesi sidakamizwa ku-plasma yegazi kwakufana kumthamo ophakeme kanye nokwelashwa okwenziwa ngomjovo.
Lezi zinhlayiya zaziphezulu kunalapho iziguli zithola umthamo ojwayelekile kuphela.
Ngokocwaningo, lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi impilo yeziguli ezihlushwa yi-tuberculosis meningitis ingathuthukiswa uma zithola imithamo ephezulu ye-rifampicin.
Akubalulekile ukuthi bayithole njengezimpuphu noma ngomjovo - okubalulekile ukuthi bathole imithamo ephezulu, ngoba izidumbu zabo ziyakwazi ukugcina izinga eliphezulu lalo.
Imiphumela isekela okutholakele kweziqu zenzame ezenziwe e-Uganda nase-Indonesia.
Imizamo emibili emincane e-Indonesia isibonelo yaphakamisa ukuthi izimpilo zeziguli eziningi kakhulu zingasindiswa uma zinikezwa imithamo ephezulu ye-rifampicin kungaba ngomlomo noma nge-intravenous.
Ngeshwa, abacwaningi baxwayisa ukuthi abahlanganyeli abambalwa abathatha ingxenye kulesi sifundo kunalokho ababekulindele ekuqaleni, okungase kube nomthelela emiphumeleni yabo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwa eNingizimu Afrika.
Kusekela uhlelo lokwenza izivivinyo ukuze kuhlolwe ukuthi kuwufanele yini ukunikeza iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis imithamo ephezulu yerifampicin.
Kuyethembeleka ukuthi ukwelashwa okunjalo kuzolondoloza izimpilo zabantu abaningi e-Afrika nasezinye izindawo zomhlaba lapho i-tuberculosis meningitis iyinkinga enkulu.
Ingabe ukusetshenziswa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-compost ne-biochar kungathuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi we-savanna osemaphethelweni ogugile kakhulu?
Ukwehla kokuvundiswa komhlabathi kuyisithiyo esikhulu ekukhiqizeni izitshalo e-sub-Saharan Africa.
Umphumela omuhle wokufaka i-biochar kanye ne-compost ekukhulelweni komhlabathi ubikwe ngababhali abaningi.

Kulesi sifundo, kwenziwe ukuhlolwa kwe-incubation yelabhorethri yezinsuku ezingama-30 kusetshenziswa amasampula angama-120 g ngayinye ye-Haplic acrisol eguqulwe nge-corn cob biochar (cbio), rice husk biochar (rbio), coconut husk biochar (coco300 kanye ne-coco700) noma umquba wezinkukhu (compost); kanye ne-co-composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) noma i-co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) ngamazinga okuguqulwa angu-1 % w/w: umhlabathi, ngokulandelana.

Ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ocwaningweni zahlanganiswa umquba wezinkukhu kanye ne-biochar ye-corn cob noma i-biochar ye-rice husk (1% umquba + 1% biochar: 1% inhlabathi w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola imiphumela yabo ekuphefumuleni kwenhlabathi okuyisisekelo, i-pH yenhlabathi; i-carbon yamagciwane enhlabathi; amandla okushintshisana ama-cation; i-carbon ephelele ye-organic, i-nitrogen ephelele kanye nokugxila kwe-nitrogen etholakalayo.
I-Biochar kanye nomquba asetshenziswa wodwa noma ndawonye, kanye ne-biochar e-composted kunyuse i-pH yomhlabathi ngamayunithi angu-0.28–2.29 we-pH uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula okungashintshiwe.

Ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo okuvela kumquba kuphela noma umquba wezinhlamvu zelayisi ezicompostiwe, noma i-biochar yamakhoba ombila noma i-biochar ehlanganisiwe nomquba kwakuphakeme kunokulawulwa okungashintshiwe, okwakufana nalokho okuvela ekwelashweni kwe-biochar kuphela.
I-TOC ekwelapheni umquba kuphela kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-biochar ye-corn cob nomquba kwakuphakeme ngo-37% no-117%, ngokulandelana, kunokulawula.

Ukusetshenziswa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-biochar yohlalu lwesitshalo sommbila kanye ne-compost kwandise i-MBC ngo-132% kuyilapho ukwengezwa kwe-compost kuphela kwandise i-MBC ngo-247%, ngokulandelana, uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawulwa.

Ekuphetheni, ucwaningo lwakhombisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwe-compost noma i-biochar kuphela, noma ukuhlanganiswa kwe-composted biochar kuthuthukise izici zekhwalithi yomhlabathi ezifana ne-pH yomhlabathi kanye ne-MBC, futhi kwakhuthaza ukuzinza kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuthuthukisa i-TOC nokunciphisa ukulahleka kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuncipha kokuphefumula okuyisisekelo.
I-Biochar kanye nomquba kuthuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi lezitshalo.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolisise ukuthi i-biochar, impahla ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni eyenziwe nge-biomass elahliwe, ingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuthuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi e-sub-Saharan Africa.
Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi i-biochar ithuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi ngendlela efanayo nezinye izindlela ezibiza kakhulu futhi ezingatholakali kalula.
Enye yezinkinga ezinkulu ezibhekene nokukhiqizwa kwezolimo e-sub-Saharan Africa ukwehla kokuvundiswa komhlabathi.
Ikhwalithi engcono yomhlabathi izoholela ekutshalweni okungcono kwezitshalo, okuzokwehlisa ububha basemakhaya futhi kubuyise ukonakala kwemithombo yemvelo.
Ucwaningo lukhombisile ukuthi i-biochar, impahla ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa inhlabathi.
I-Biochar umkhiqizo ongatholakali lapho kushiswa izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, lapho kunokuncane noma kungekho umoya-mpilo.
I-Biochar kuboniswe ukuthi yandisa indawo engaphezulu yomhlabathi, yandisa ukutholakala kwamanzi nomoya, futhi ivuselele ama-microorganism emhlabathini.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolile umphumela we-biochar kanye ne-compost ekutheni izinga lomhlabathi lisebenzisa izinkomba ezifana nokuphefumula komhlabathi, i-pH yomhlabathi, ukuba khona kwamagciwane, inani le-carbon, kanye nenani le-nitrogen etholakalayo.

Abacwaningi bakhiqiza ama-biochar esiqu sombila, ukhakhayi lwekhokhonathi kanye nogobolondo lwerayisi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis, ebandakanya ukufudumeza izinto eziphilayo ngaphandle komoya-mpilo, ku-450 °C esithandweni esikhiqizwe endaweni.
Abacwaningi bakhiqiza i-biochar yesikhumba sekhokhonathi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis ku-300 °C naku-700 °C.
Abacwaningi base befaka amasampula omhlabathi ahlanganiswe nama-biochar izinsuku ezingama-30.

Isampula ngalinye liqukethe inhlabathi ekhethekile ebizwa ngokuthi i-Haplic acrisol, eyayixutshwe nezinhlanganisela ezihlukene zama-biochar enziwe ngotshani bekhoba likakolweni, ikhoba lerayisi noma ikhoba likakhukhunathi, kanye nomquba wezinkukhu.
Ezinye izampula zaziqukethe inhlanganisela yomhlabathi kanye nomquba wezinkukhu, ne-rice husk biochar, kanye ne-corn cob biochar, ngokulandelana.
Isampula ngalinye liqukethe u-1% womquba, u-1% we-biochar ngayinye, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuphenya umphumela wenhlanganisela ngayinye ekutheni ikhwalithi yomhlabathi.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwengeza i-biochar kanye ne-compost enhlabathini, kungaba ngokuhlukana noma ndawonye, kwandise inani le-pH yenhlabathi kusuka ku-0.28–2.29 amayunithi e-pH, uma kuqhathaniswa nenhlabathi engaxutshwe.
Ukukhuphuka kwe-pH kusho ukuthi umhlabathi awusaba muncu kangako.

Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa umhlabathi, lenyuka uma kungezwa umquba wodwa, noma uma umquba uxutshwe nesikhumba selayisi, noma i-biochar ye-corn cob noma ama-biochar ahlanganisiwe.

Amasampula omhlabathi akhombisile ukwanda kokuqukethwe okuphelele kwekhabhoni ye-organic ngo-37% lapho kusetshenziswa umquba kuphela, kanye nokwanda ngo-117% lapho i-corn cob biochar ixutshwe nomquba.
Inani lomsebenzi wezinto ezincane landa ngo-132% lapho inhlabathi yayinezingxube ze-compost kanye ne-rice husk biochar, kuqhathaniswa nokwanda ngo-247% emasampuleni enhlabathi ayene-compost kuphela.
Imiphumela yocwaningo lolu ikhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukunciphisa ubuhlungu benhlabathi usebenzisa i-biochar, etholakala kalula futhi ngentengo ephansi.
Lokhu kuhluke kumkhuba ohlukile wokufaka i-lime enhlabathini, okuyinto ebiza kakhulu futhi engatholakali kalula kubalimi abancane e-sub-Saharan Africa.
Inethiwekhi Yezinhlayiya Zefayibrini Ezingajwayelekile ku-Rheumatoid Arthritis kanye Nobudlelwano Bayo Nokuzivikela Emzimbeni, Ukuvuvukala Nokwakheka Kwamaqhina Egazi
Ingozi yezigameko zenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi ezigulini ezine-RA ikhuphuka ngokungalingani ngenxa yokuvuvukala kwesistimu.
Umphumela ohlobene wokuhlangana kwe-autoimmune-associated citrullination esakhiweni kanye namandla okubangela i-thrombosis ye-fibrin(ogen) usalokhu ungaziwa.

Ngakho-ke, siqhathanise izinkomba zomsebenzi wamithambo yegazi, ukuvuvukala, ukujiya kwegazi kanye nokwakheka kwefayibrini kumalungu ane-RA nalabo abaphilile futhi sihlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwezinkomba.
Izampula zegazi zaqoqwa kubaguli be-RA abangama-30 kanye nabazithandela abaphilile abangu-25 abalingana ngeminyaka nobulili.
Amazinga e-SAA, CRP, ICAM-1 kanye ne-VCAM-1 akalwe kusetshenziswa i-sandwich immunoassay.
Ukubumbana kwegazi eliphelele kwahlolwa kusetshenziswa i-Thromboelastography.
Izinkundla zamangqamuzana e-fibrin kanye nesakhiwo se-fiber kuphenywe kusetshenziswa i-Scanning Electron Microscopy.
Ukutholwa nokulinganiswa kwe-citrullination kuma-fibrin clots akhiwe kwenziwa kusetshenziswa i-Citrulline monoclonal antibody enelebuli ye-fluorescent nge-Confocal Microscopy.
Ukugxiliswa kwe-SAA, CRP kanye ne-ICAM-1 bekuphakeme kakhulu ezigulini ze-RA uma kuqhathaniswa nezilawuli.

Imingcele ye-TEG ephathelene nokuqala kokuhlangana kwegazi (R no-K), izinga lokuxhumana kwe-fibrin (α-Angle), nesikhathi sokufinyelela ekukhiqizeni i-thrombus enkulu kakhulu (TMRTG) yayinciphisiwe kubaguli be-RA.
Amapharamitha ahlobene namandla ehlule (MA, MRTG, TGG) awazange ahluke ngokwezibalo phakathi kwe-RA nezilawuli.
Ukulinganisa kwe-logistic regression kuveze ukuhlobana okuqinile phakathi kwezinto eziphendulayo zesigaba esibuhlungu (CRP, SAA) namapharamitha e-TEG kunamaphawu okusebenza kwe-endothelial.

Ukuhlaziywa okuncane kwembule amanethiwekhi aminyene amafayibha e-fibrin aqinile ezigulini ze-RA uma kuqhathaniswa nezilawuli [isilinganiso (interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm ngokulandelana, p<0.0001, Odds ratio=22.7).
Ukutholwa kwezigaba eziningi ezine-citrullination ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zefibrin clot ezigulini ze-RA, okwakungavamile emasampuleni okulawula (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Iziguli ezine-RA esebenzayo zibonisa iphrofayela yokuhlangana kwegazi ehlukile kokutholakele okuvamile okuhlotshaniswa nezinye izimo zokuvuvukala.

Ukuguqulwa kwezakhiwo zephrotheni ngokuhlangene nesifo sokuzivikela somzimba esihlobene ne-citrullination kungadlala indima ekunqumeni isakhiwo se-fibrin kanye namandla okubangela ubungozi obukhulu be-thrombotic ezigulini ze-RA.
Ukubumbana kwegazi ezigulini ezine-arthritis kungachaza ubungozi babo obukhulayo bokuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo, isifo sohlangothi.
Ucwaningo olusha mayelana ne-rheumatoid arthritis lunikeze ukuqonda okungcono kwezixhumanisi ezingaba khona phakathi kwalesi simo kanye nokwanda kobungozi bezifo zenhliziyo.
Isifo i-rheumatoid arthritis (RA) isimo esibuhlungu nesikhubazayo sokuzivikela komzimba, esihlotshaniswa nokuvuvukala emalungeni nasemzimbeni wonke.

Sekuyisikhathi esithile manje, ososayensi bayazi ukuthi abagulayo balesi sifo baphinde babe nengozi ephakeme ngo-50% yokuthola imiphumela yesifo senhliziyo nemithambo (CVD) – njengokuhlaselwa wumhlane noma ukuhlaselwa yisifo senhliziyo.
Isici esiyinhloko salowo mngcipheko umphumela wokuvuvukala enawo enqubweni yokuhlangana kwegazi.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bahlolisise lobu budlelwano, ukuthola ukuthi kungani ngempela i-RA yandisa ubungozi be-CVD.
Ngokucacile, abacwaningi bahlolisise imiphumela yokuvuvukala nezinguquko zesakhiwo kumaphrotheni athile ahlobene nokuhlangana kwegazi, abizwa ngokuthi ama-fibrin.

Lezi ziprotheni zenzeka njengezixhumanisi ezinde ezakha "inethiwekhi" eyisisekelo yezibazi zegazi, ngakho noma yiziphi izinguquko kuma-fibrins ngokwawo zingaba nemiphumela emibi yenqubo yokubopha igazi iyonke.
Abacwaningi baqhathanise amasampula egazi eziguli ze-RA namasampula avela kubantu abanempilo.

Kwesinye nesinye isimo, abacwaningi bebefuna "izimpawu" egazini ezikhombisa ukuvuvukala, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingajwayelekile enqubweni evamile yokubumbana kwegazi ezingakhulisa ingozi ye-CVD.
Amahlule angawodwana nawo ahlaziywa ngokomakroskopu, ukuze kutholwe noma yiziphi izinguquko esakhiweni samaprotheni awo e-fibrin.

Abacwaningi baphawule ukuthi izigaxa ezivela ezigulini ze-RA zakheka ngokushesha kunezalezo kubantu abaphilile, futhi izintambo zephrotheni ezazenziwe ngazo zaziphinde zibe zinkulu kakhulu kunezintambo ze-fibrin ezijwayelekile.
Kuphinde kwaba nezinguquko kuma-amino acid akha amaphrotheni e-fibrin, okwadala ukuthi asuse impendulo yokuzivikela yomzimba, okuholela ekuqhakazeni okwengeziwe.
Abanye abacwaningi baye baqaphela izinguquko esakhiweni se-amino acid samafibrin emalungeni eziguli ze-RA ngaphambili, kodwa lokhu kungokokuqala abacwaningi bebona umphumela ofanayo egazini.

Kuhlanganiswe nezinye izinguquko ezibonwe kumathumba egazi, okutholakele kungasiza ososayensi ukuthuthukisa ukuqonda okujulile kobudlelwane phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD, nokuthi ungabheka kanjani izimpawu zokuqala zalezi zifo.
Nakuba le miphumela yokuqala ithembisa, kufanelekile ukuqaphela ukuthi usayizi wesampula socwaningo wawumancane uma kuqhathaniswa.

Abacwaningi baphinde baphawula ukuthi indlela abayisebenzisile ukuthola izinguquko zama-amino acid kumaphrotheni kungenzeka ukuthi iphinde yathola imiphumela evela ezintweni ezingahlangene, okusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa okuqondene kakhulu okuhloswe ngama-fibrin ukuqinisekisa umphumela esikhathini esizayo.

Esikhathini eside, ukuqonda izixhumanisi eziyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kwe-RA kanye nengozi eyandayo ye-CVD kungathuthukisa imiphumela yeziguli ze-RA njengoba sifunda ukubona nokwelapha lezi zifo ngokuphumelela okukhulu.
Abacwaningi abavela eNingizimu Afrika, eDenmark nase-United Kingdom babambe iqhaza kulolu cwaningo, oluxhaswe yi-South African Medical Research Council.
Izibikezelo zezulu zasolwandle kubasebenzisi basogwini lolwandle – imibono, ukusetshenziswa nokwamukelwa
Ucwaningo lwamanje luhlose ukubhekana nokungaxhumani phakathi kwesayensi nomphakathi ngendlela yokungahambisani okungenzeka ekunikezeni nasekufuneni kolwazi okwaziwa ngokuthi igebe lokusetshenziswa.
Kulokhu, sihlola ukubaluleka kolwazi lwezulu lolwandle (metocean) njengoba lubonwa ngabasebenzisi emazweni amabili aseNingizimu Yomhlaba:
iNingizimu Afrika kanye neNew Zealand.
Lapha, ukugxila akukhona kuphela emibonweni, ekusebenzisweni nasekwamukelweni kwezibikezelo zezenzakalo ezinzima kodwa kugxile ekubandakanyeni okuvamile, okujwayelekile kwezibikezelo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwa ngohlelo locwaningo, olwaklanywa luzungeze imibuzo emithathu yocwaningo.

Imibuzo yocwaningo ihlanganisa izihloko ezisukela kumathuluzi okubikezela i-ergonomics, ukunemba nokungaguquguquki, ukusetshenziswa kalula, isithunzi sezinhlangano, kanye nokungaqiniseki okuhlobene nezinguquko zesimo sezulu (ukukhuluma ezimbalwa nje).
Inhlolovo eku-inthanethi yasatshalaliswa kabanzi ukuze ifake abasebenzisi bezokuzijabulisa kanye nabathengisayo.
Ucwaningo lwalugxile ekutholeni izindlela zokwenza izinqumo ezingase zithinte izidingo zolwazi lwabasebenzisi bolwandle abasogwini ngendlela ehlukile.

Ukuhlaziywa kokuvumelana kwamasiko (CCA) kwasetshenziswa ukuphenya ukuqonda okuhlanganyelwe kanye nokuhluka emibonweni phakathi kweqembu eliphelele labaphendulayo kanye nakumaqembu amancane asuselwa emikhakheni nasezifundeni.

Sithole amazinga ahlukahlukene okuvumelana eqenjini lonke (abathathi-nxaxheba abavela kuzo zombili izizwe nakuwo wonke amasekhtha ahlangene) uma kuqhathaniswa namaqembu amancane ahlukene wabasebenzisi.

Bonke abahlanganyeli abathathwe ndawonye babonisa ukuvumelana okulingene kwamasiko mayelana nezinkinga ezethulwe kodwa ngokuhlukahluka okuthile kokubuka ezingeni lezwe, okuphakamisa amasiko angaphansi kungenzeka.

Sihlaziya amaqembu amancane kazwelonke nawemboni ngokwehlukana, sithole ukuvumelana kwesiko okuhambisana kakhulu eqenjini labasebenzisi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana okuqinile kungakhathalekile ukuhlobana kwemboni.
Iqembu labasebenzisi bezentengiselwano baseNew Zealand libe nokuvumelana okungatheni nawo wonke amanye amaqembu amancane.
Sihlahla imiphumela etholakele mayelana nezici ezibalulekile ekuthathweni kwezinsiza ngakho-ke nasekukhiqizweni kwezibikezelo ezivelele.
Izinto eziningi ezibekwe phambili eziphathelene nezibikezelo ezisuselwe kwesayensi esikhathini esizayo zibonakaliswa futhi, kucatshangelwa imithelela elindelekile yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.
Siyaphetha ngokuphakamisa idayagramu yomqondo ukuze kugqanyiswe ukubambisana okubalulekile phakathi kokuthuthukiswa komkhiqizo wesibikezelo nokunemba/ukuvumelana kwesayensi.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, abaseNew Zealand bathemba izibikezelo zesimo sezulu olwandle

Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nabaseNew Zealand abasebenza nabahlala ezindaweni ezisogwini bathembele ezinsizeni zezibikezelo zesimo sezulu ezilula ukuzisebenzisa, futhi ezihlala zinikeza izibikezelo ezinembile.
Izinsizakalo zokubikezela zesizwe kanye namawebhusayithi ahlukahlukene ezentengiso zinikeza izibikezelo mayelana nokuthi isimo sezulu sizoba yini.
Bazama ukuba nembile futhi basize ngangokunokwenzeka.
Inqwaba yesayensi nokucabanga kwesayensi kungena kulokhu kubikezela.

Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bakhethe ukubheka ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika naseNew Zealand basebenzisa kanjani izinsiza zokubikezela – womabili la mazwe anogwini olude, kodwa anabantu abahlukene kakhulu nezimo zasogwini ezihlukene kakhulu.

Bafuna ukuthola ukuthi kaningi kangakanani lezi zakhisane zasogwini zisebenzisa izinsiza zokubikezela zezulu zikazwelonke noma ezentengiso, ngeziphi izinhloso futhi ukuthi bazithola ziwusizo futhi zithembekile yini.
Lezi zinto ezibalulekile maqondana nokuthi izinguquko zesimo sezulu ezizayo zingase zithinte kanjani ukubikezela kwesimo sezulu.
Kuhlelo lombuzo oluku-inthanethi lwaphendulwa abantu abangama-31 baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nabangu-126 baseNew Zealand.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngezinhloso zomsebenzi (isibonelo abalobi bezinhlanzi nezinhlangano zokusesha nokuhlenga), nabanye abahlanganyela kwezemidlalo nasemisebenzini yokuzijabulisa ephathelene nolwandle njengokugibela amagagasi, ukuhamba ngebhodi, noma ukubhukuda.
Abacwaningi babuza ukuthi kulula kangakanani ukusebenzisa insiza yokubikezela isimo sezulu abayithandayo, nokuthi izibikezelo zayo zazichanile futhi zihambisana kangakanani.
Ababambiqhaza babhale phansi izici ezibenza kube usizo futhi kubaluleke kubo futhi bathe ukuthi lezi zinto zingashintsha yini ngenxa yokuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Kwakudingeka baphinde bathi bayethemba yini ulwazi olunikezwa izinsiza zezulu zikazwelonke, nokuthi bazizwa kanjani ngalo.
Iningi labaNingizimu Afrika ababe yingxenye yocwaningo kwakungabasubathi basolwandle, noma abantu ababasiza ngemisebenzi yokusesha nokuhlenga noma amaphrojekthi ocwaningo.
Iningi labaNew Zealand abaphendule imibuzo babheka izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngoba babefuna ukuya ezokudoba, ukuhamba ngesikebhe noma ukuhamba ngomkhumbi olwandle.
Abahlanganyeli abavela emazweni womabili bathembela olwazini olunikezwe kubo yizinsizakalo zezulu zikazwelonke.
Babethanda izinsiza zokubikezela ezinembile, ezihambisanayo, ezilula ukuzisebenzisa futhi ezinezici ezingaguqulelwa ukuze zihambisane nezidingo zabo.
Abahlanganyeli abasebenzise insiza ngezinhloso zomsebenzi ngokujwayelekile bathole ukuthi izibikezelo zezimo zasolwandle eziseduze nogu bezingaqondile ngokwanele.
Ulwazi lwezinye izindawo belunembe kakhudlwana kunezinye.
Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bavame ukusebenzisa izinsiza zezulu kaningi kunezakwaNew Zealand, futhi babheka okungenani kanye ngosuku.
Kwabayisishiyagalolunye kwabayi-10 abaphendulayo, uhlelo lokubikezela oluhle kakhulu lwalubaluleke kakhulu.
Iningi labantu bakhetha insiza enikeza ukubuka kusengaphambili kwezinsuku ezintathu kuya kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa.
Abantu abasebenza ekufuyweni kwezinhlanzi noma ababehlela izimo eziphuthumayo ezingenzeka babefuna izibikezelo zesikhathi eside nezesizini.

Iningi labasebenzisi likholelwa ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu, izinsiza zokubikezela kuzofanele zisebenzise ulwazi olusekelwe kwisayensi olungcono kakhulu esikhathini esizayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukubikezela okunembile.
Izifundo ezinjalo ezimbalwa kakhulu ziye zenziwa ngaphambilini emazweni aseNingizimu Nenkabazwe.
Abacwaningi banethemba lokuthi baphumelele ukufunda okwanele kubabambiqhaza ngokusekelwe emibuzweni abayibuze kubo.
Ubuthakathaka obungenzeka futhi ukuthi abantu abaningi abahlala eNew Zealand kunaseNingizimu Afrika babambe iqhaza ocwaningweni.
Umsebenzi wabo uzosiza abantu abasebenzela izinsiza zokubikezela isimo sezulu ukuthi baklame imikhiqizo engcono egcina izidingo zamakhasimende abo engqondweni.
Bazokwazi ukwenza ngcono nezinguquko ngokusekelwe ekwanelisekeni kwamakhasimende abo nangokuthi kungani bewasebenzisa.
Indlela Yokubamba Iqhaza Ekulinganiseni Ukuhlakanipha Kwesimo Sezulu Sokungenelela Kwezolimo:
Icala LaseLushoto
Umqondo wezolimo ezihlakaniphile ngezulu (CSA) uthola umfutho emhlabeni wonke.
Nokho, akucacile ukuthi yini okufanele ihlanganiswe ngaphansi kwezinsika zayo ezintathu—ukukhiqiza, ukumelana nezimo kanye nokunciphisa umonakalo.
Ngakho-ke, i-CSA ihlanganisa izindlela/ubuchwepheshe obuningi obuhlukene bezolimo, okwenza kube nzima ukubeka phambili izinhloso ze-CSA.
Okokuqala, kukhona ukusweleka kwezindlela ezicacile nezisebenzayo kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ukuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu sokungenelela.
Okwesibili, kunolwazi oluncane olukhona mayelana nomthelela wezinyathelo ezahlukahlukene esezivele zakhushulelwa njenge-CSA, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni othuthukayo.
Ekugcineni, ukuhlelwa kwe-CSA akubheki imibono yabathintekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ziyasebenza, ziyafaneleka futhi zinenketho ephezulu yokwamukelwa.
Lapha, sichaza uhlelo olusha lokubamba iqhaza lokuhlola ukuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu kwezokungenelela kwezolimo emikhubeni yabalimi abancane.
Lokhu kukhomba izinkomba zezinga lepulazi (kanye nezinkomba) zezinsika zokuphepha kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo ze-CSA.
Kuphinde kusekele ukukalwa kwabakhombisi ngokubamba iqhaza, okuvumela ukuhlolwa okuyisisekelo kanye nokuzayo kobuhlakani bezulu ukuthi kwenziwe.
Uhlelo lwavivinywa phakathi kwabafuyi abangama-72 abenza izindlela ezihlukahlukene ze-CSA edolobhaneni elihlakaniphile ngezulu iLushoto, eTanzania.

Abalimi bakubaluleka kakhulu ukungenela okuthuthukisa umvundiso nokwakheka komhlabathi, ukunciphisa ukuhamba kwamanzi phezu komhlaba, nokubuyisa umhlaba owohlokile ngenxa yemithelela emihle ekukhiqizeni nasekulimeni kwezolimo ngaphandle kwesizini.
Ikakhulu, izinyathelo ze-CSA zikhuphule ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukukhiqizwa kokudla, ukusetshenziswa kanye nemali engenayo.
Iphrothokholi kulula ukuyivumelanisa nezifunda ezihlukene kanye nezinhlelo zokulima futhi ivumela ukugcizelelwa okungcono kwezinyathelo zok intervenisha.
Kodwa sincoma ukuthi i-CSA yamukelwe njengengxenye yenqubo yokuhlola, ukuhlaziya kanye nokufunda.
Izindlela ezintsha zokuhlola zisiza ososayensi nabalimi ukulungiselela ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu.
Ososayensi abasebenza nabalimi e-Tanzania manje sebengalinganisa ukuthi izindlela ezintsha zokulima zisebenza kahle kangakanani ekunciphiseni imithelela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu.
Bafisa ukuthi indlela yabo izothuthukisa ukuphepha kokudla nokuvuna izitshalo kubalimi kwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba futhi.
"Agriculture esebenzisa izindlela ezihlakaniphile zemvelo" into iZizwe Ezihlangene ezikhuthaza yona ukusiza abalimi abancane ukuthi balungiselele izinguquko zesimo sezulu.
Umlimi ohlakaniphile ngokwesimo sezulu uyakwazi ukujwayela izimo zezulu ezishintshashintshayo futhi uyakwazi ukukhulisa ukuphepha kokudla ngokwandisa ukukhiqiza kwezolimo.
Lolu udaba olubaluleke kakhulu kubalimi baseTanzania, njengoba izwe selivele libhekene nokwehla kokukhiqizwa kwezitshalo ezibalulekile zokusanhlamvu ngenxa yezinguquko zesimo sezulu.

Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukukala impumelelo yezinyathelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile zemvelo, ezifana nokuvundisa, futhi abalimi uqobo lwabo abahlale bebuzwa ukuthi ngabe izinyathelo zisebenza njengoba kuhlosiwe yini.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuklama indlela yokukala impumelelo yezinyathelo zokuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu, begxile kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni ukuphepha kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
Ukuqala, bafunda ezinye izifundo zezolimo futhi bakhiqiza izinhlu ezingu-2 ezihlanganisa izici ezingu-14, noma “izinkomba”, ezibalulekile ekulinganiseni ukuphepha kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
Bese kusebenza esiFundeni saseLushoto eTanzania, abacwaningi basebenzisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe bezolimo abaningana ukuze bakhombe izinkomba ezibaluleke kakhulu ohlwini ngalunye.
Abalimi bakhombe ukukhiqizwa kokudla njengesikhombisi esibaluleke kakhulu sokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla.
Ngamanye amazwi, noma yiziphi izinyathelo ezathuthukisa isivuno sezitshalo zabo zazibaluleka kakhulu.

Khonamanjalo, mayelana nesici sokuzivumelanisa nezimo, abalimi babe nentshisekelo ikakhulukazi ezinhlelweni ezibasizayo ukuvikela umhlabathi wezindawo zabo zokulima, kanye nalezo ezithuthukisa ulwazi lwabo siqu, amakhono, kanye nemali engenayo.
Uma abacwaningi sebehlonze ukubaluleka kwesikhombi ngasinye, bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ukuhlola ukuthi izinhlobo eziyisithupha zokungenelela eLushoto zaziphumelele yini.
Kukho konke icala, babuza abalimi bendawo, ngokwesilinganiso esingu-1 kuya ku-5, ukuthi ngabe kube nokwanda esikhombisweni ngasinye kusukela kwathi kwaqala ukungenelela.
Lokhu kubavumele ukuba babone ukuthi yiziphi izinyathelo ezazinomthelela oqinile ekuphepheni kokudla nasekuvumelaneni nezimo.
Bathole ukuthi izinyathelo ezi-3 kuphela kweziyi-6 ezazisetshenziswa zaba nomthelela wangempela.
Leyo kwakuyizinhlobo zokuvundisa, izinhlobo zezitshalo ezibekezelela isomiso, nokuhlinzeka ngokudla okungcono kwezilwane zokudla.
Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinyathelo ezizayo zihlangabezana nezidingo zabalimi baseLushoto kanye nezinhloso zezolimo ezihlakaniphile ngokwesimo sezulu.
Bathi ukukhetha izinyathelo ezifanele nakho kwandisa amathuba okuthi abalimi batusa izindlela ezinhle kubakhelwane babo, ngaleyo ndlela basakaze imibono ehlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.

Ngokwemigomo ebanzi, le ndlela ingase isetshenziswe nakwezinye izifunda, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu ahlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu abheka izimo zendawo kanye nolwazi lwabalimi ngokuhlola okuqhubekayo nokuhlola.
Ngokwenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zokulima ezihlakaniphile ngokwesimo sezulu kungenzeka zibe nempumelelo futhi zithole ukwamukelwa, kokubili eTanzania nakwezinye izindawo e-Afrika.
Ucwaningo lwaluyintsebenziswano phakathi kososayensi abavela eKenya naseNetherlands.
Izifo Ezibangelwa Amagciwane Ezilwaneni Ezinezinhlaka Zegazi Njengezinhlobo Ezihlaselayo: Ukuqonda Okuvela eNingizimu Afrika
Ucwaningo ngamagciwane ezifo njengama-species angaphandle ahlaselayo alutholanga ukunakwa okukhulu emkhakheni wesayensi yokuhlasela.
Izifo ezingenisiwe zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezinhlakeni eziphilayo, ezindaweni zemvelo abahlala kuzo, kanye nezomnotho ezisekelwa yilezo zindawo zemvelo.

Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zamacala ezifo ezingenisiwe ezifuywayo nezilwane zasendle (isithuthwane sezinja, isifo sofuba sezinkomo, ne-rinderpest) nabantu (i-smallpox, imasisi kanye negciwane elibangela ukuntuleka kwamandla omzimba, i-HIV) ukukhombisa izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zifo ezingaba nayo.

Umthelela obaluleke kakhulu kuze kube manje kwakuwukugula kwezinkomo, okwadala ukufa kwezigidi zezimvu, futhi kwacishe kwabhubhisa izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu zeningizimu ye-Afrika.
Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwaholela ekushintsheni okukhulu kwesakhiwo kanye nezimo zama-ecosystem.
Umkhuhlane we-Rinderpest usulahlwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa zombili i-rabies yezinja kanye nomtshwayo wamathumbu ezinkomo kusasele, futhi ukuqapha okuqhubekayo nokuphathwa kuzodingeka ukuze kuvinjwe.
Kwezifo zabantu, umalaleveva nawo usulahlwe emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa umphumela wesifo, owangeniswa ngabahlali baseYurophu, wawubhubhisa kakhulu.

Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-1700, ingxenye enkulu (kuze kufike ku-90% kwezinye izindawo) yabantu bomdabu bakwaKhoekhoe yashona, kwabhujiswa isiko labo nendlela yabo yokuphila, kwashiywa abasindile abambalwa ukuba baqashwe njengabasebenzi basemapulazini.
I-HIV, eqale yatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982 nayo ibe nemiphumela emikhulu futhi ukwelashwa ngama-antiretroviral kuphela okwamanje kubiza uhulumeni u-ZAR 66.4 billion ngonyaka.
Siphinde sifake i-West Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo eziqale e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni wonke.
Silindele ukuthi izifo ezintsha zizovela njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokwandisa ububanzi babo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba umthamo wezohwebo ukhula.
Abacwaningi bazi ini ngabaqhamukayo abancane kakhulu ababangela izifo eNingizimu Afrika

Lesi sahluko sencwadi sifingqa ulwazi lwakamuva ngezifo ezifana nesifo sokuwa kwezinkomo, isifo sohudo, isifo somphimbo kanye ne-HIV, zonke ezibangelwa izilwanyana ezincane ezihlaselayo (amagciwane, amabhaktheriya nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezithathwa njengezinhlobo ezingezona ezendawo, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile).
Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqhambuka kwezifo kugcina kulimaza umnotho wezwe.
Emkhakheni wocwaningo obizwa ngokuthi 'isayensi yokungena', ososayensi bafunda ngezinto eziphilayo ezikhula futhi zibe yingozi ngemva kokwethulwa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali ngokuvamile.
Ucwaningo oluningi lugxile kakhulu "ezinhlotsheni ezinkulu ezihlaselayo" ezifana nezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa abahlaseli abancane ababangela izifo babaluleke ngokufanayo.
Kulesi sahluko, ababhali baxoxe ngezinye izifo zezilwane nezabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezibangelwa yilezo zinhlobonhlobo zemibungu efakwe.
Bathi ubungozi obukhulu kakhulu kwakuyisifo se-'rinderpest', esatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
I-Rinderpest yabangelwa yigciwane futhi yathinta izinkomo nezinyathi.
Igciwane elifanayo libangele isifo somasisi kubantu.
Abantu abaningi basemaphandleni babhekana nendlala ngemuva kokugqashuka kuka-1896, kodwa lesi sifo manje sesiqediwe ngokugoma.
Ababhali bathi phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861, izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zazinesifo se-rabies, nakuba abantu babengazi ukuthi lesi kwakuyisifo sini.
Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi umkhuhlane wamarabi ubangelwa yigciwane, ngakho uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezithintekile nokugoma lezo ezingathintekile.
Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuqede lesi sifo futhi sisathinta izilwane zasendle eziningi ezifana nezimbabala, amakhosi, izinja zasendle, omhunti kanye namaxoxo.
Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, izingane ezimbili zalunywa yiYellow Mongoose zashona ngenxa ye-rabies.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, isifo se-rabies saba yinto ejwayelekile eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathi ngo-1954, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabo bathinteka yisifo somasisi.
Ngesikhathi lesi sahluko sasibhalwa, isifo somasikane sasibulala cishe izingane ezingu-400 nsuku zonke.
Bathi isibhaxu sasivamile lapho abantu nezinkomo bebesondelene kakhulu.
Ababhali baphinde bakhuluma ngesifo esibizwa ngokuthi i-bovine tuberculosis (BTB), esibangelwa amagciwane.
I-BTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, izindlulamithi, amakhehla, amabhubesi, izikhova, amabhunu kanye namabhubesi.
Bathi isifo se-BTB kwabikwa okokuqala epaki kazwelonke yaseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Uhulumeni walawula lesi sifo ngokubulala izinyathi ezazithelelekile.
Ababhali bathi elinye igciwane, elalingeniswe eNingizimu Afrika ngabahambi abavela eYurophu, labangela isifo esibizwa ngokuthi ‘isibhaxu’ kubantu.
Lesi sifo sabulala ngaphezu kuka-90% wabantu bendawo baseKhoekhoe.
Ekupheleni kokugqashuka kwesifo, isiko lamaKhoekhoe lalisiphantshile cishe ngokuphelele.
Ababhali baphinde babika ngegciwane lokukhubazeka komzimba (HIV) elabangela ukuqubuka kwesifo i-AIDS.
Ososayensi basacabanga ukuthi igciwane laqala ukudluliselwa kubantu livela ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-zoonosis.
Igciwane laqala ukutholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Bathi, kusukela ngo-2019, i-HIV yayingekho umuthi wokugoma noma ukwelapha.
Baphethe isahluko ngokukhuluma nge-West Nile Virus kanye ne-African Swine Fever, abathi kwaqhamuka e-Afrika kwasabalala eYurophu naseMelika.
Igciwane le-West Nile ladluliselwa ngoshaka futhi labulala ikakhulukazi izinyoni, kodwa liphinde lathinta amahhashi nabantu.
Bathi izilwane ezifana nezimpungushe nezimbongolo zasendle zidlulisela isifo se-African swine fever.
Isifo sathinta izinkukhu, futhi sathinta kakhulu amabhizinisi ezinkukhu.
Ababhali bathe baxoxe kuphela ngezifo ezibangelwa amagciwane namagciwane, ngakho-ke lesi sahluko asiyona incazelo ephelele yazo zonke izinto eziphilayo ezihlaselayo.
Ababhali babesuka eNingizimu Afrika.
I-algorithm esekelwe ebufakazini yokuhlinzwa yokuphathwa kwe-Odontogenic keratocyst
Ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kuhlala kuyisihloko esithakazelisayo nesididayo ezincwadini zokuhlinzwa kwe-Oral neMaxillofacial.
Njengamanje, kunokuntuleka kokuvumelana mayelana nokwelashwa okufanele kakhulu kweziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst.

Kuzo zonke izindlela zokwelapha ezitholakalayo, ayikho indlela eboniswe kuze kube manje ukuthi inezinga lokuphindaphinda elinguziro noma eliseduze noziro ngaphandle kokususwa okubanzi ngemiphetho ecacile.

Ngenxa yokushoda okukhona kwemibandela yokuhlinza esekelwe ebufakazini ekuphatheni iziguli ezinama-odontogenic keratocyst ezincwadini, lolu cwaningo luhlose ukwethula i-algorithm yokuhlinza, esekelwe emiphumeleni ye-meta-analysis, ethemba ukuthi izoba usizo ekuthuthukiseni ukwelashwa kweziguli ezinesimo lesi.

Sisebenzisa izilawuli ezilandelayo; usayizi, uhlobo lwe-lesion (oluyinhloko noma olwesibili), isimo se-syndromic noma esizimele se-lesion, ubukhona bezimbobo ze-cortical, kanye ne-locularity; sethula isihlahla sokwenza izinqumo, ukusiza ukuhlela ukwelashwa nokusiza ukufinyelela amathuba aphansi kakhulu okubuyela emuva ekuphatheni i-odontogenic keratocyst.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa izindlela zokwelapha kangcono isifo somhlathi

Ngokuhlanganisa imiphumela evela ezifundweni ezikhona, abacwaningi bachaze izinyathelo ezicacile ezingalandelwa odokotela ukuze bathole futhi baphathe iziguli ezinesifo samazinyo esibizwa ngokuthi ‘odontogenic keratocyst’ (OKC).
I-OKC iyisilonda, noma ukukhula okungajwayelekile, emhlathini womuntu.
Odokotela bathola lesi simo sinzima ukwelapha, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthuthukisa esinye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa ngempumelelo.
Odokotela ngakho-ke bafuna izindlela zokuphulukisa ngempumelelo nangokuhlala unomphela lezi zilonda zamhlathi.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna izinyathelo ezibalulekile odokotela okufanele bazithathe ukuze bakhombe futhi baphathe isifo.
Bakwenza lokhu ngokusesha imibhalo ekhona, noma izihloko zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Bebefuna ngqo ulwazi lokuthi odokotela baphatha kanjani i-OKC esikhathini esingangonyaka owodwa, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ezingama-46 ababezitholile.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kubesilisa kunabesifazane, futhi yayingenzeka kubantu kuze kube seminyakeni engu-90, nakuba yayivamile phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 no-30.
Isifo sithinte kakhulu umhlathi ongezansi.
I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi emathanjeni, ngokuvuvukala kwamahlathi okubonakala kuphela kamuva.
Iziguli ngokuvamile bezizwa ubuhlungu futhi kube nokuphuma okuthile (uketshezi, njengobovu, oluphuma kusilonda noma isilonda), futhi izimpande zamazinyo azo zingase ziphume endaweni yazo.
Bacebise ukuthi odokotela basuse lonke leli lesi kanye namazinyo aseduze.

Uma sebekhishiwe, kufanele basebenzise umuthi obizwa ngokuthi i-Carnoy’s solution, kanye ne-nitrojeni ewuketshezi (uketshezi olubandayo kakhulu olusetshenziselwa ukususa isikhumba esilimele ngokushesha) kanye ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi i-5FU, umuthi ojwayelekile womdlavuza).
Ngemuva kwalokhu kwelashwa, abacwaningi batusa ukuthi isiguli kufanele sibe nokuhlolwa kwezempilo okuqhubekayo kuze kufike eminyakeni engama-25.
Bathi le ndlela yokwelapha yayihamba phambili kumalonda amancane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Ngama-lesion amakhulu kune-3 cm, abacwaningi batusa ukunakwa okwengeziwe.
Bathi odokotela kufanele baqale ngokwehlisa ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilonda bese besusa uketshezi, futhi basuse zonke izicubu ezizungeze umhlathi.
Ubunxele kufanele buphathwe ngesixazululo sika-Carnoy.
Baphakamise ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlolisisise laba baguli njalo ezinyangeni ezimbili iminyaka emibili.
Uma isiguli sinamanxeba amaningi, odokotela bangakwazi ukuwakhuculula besebenzisa ezinye izinsiza ezikhethekile zesibhedlela.
Kodwa ngokujwayelekile, izifundo ezibuyekeziwe zibonise ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa i-lesion bese befaka i-5FU, iziguli bezingeke ziphinde zithole i-OKC.
Bapheceleli nokho ukuthi ubufakazi balezi zindlela zokwelapha abuhlali buqinile, futhi bathole izihloko zesayensi ezimbalwa mayelana nalesi sihloko.

Abacwaningi nabo abazange benze izivivinyo zabo ukuhlinzeka ngalezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazama ukuhlanganisa izinketho zokwelashwa ezaziwa kahle kakhulu ezivela ezifundweni ezenziwe abanye abacwaningi.
Laba bacwaningi, abazinze eNigeria nase-USA, baphakamise izifundo ezengeziwe emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuhlolwe impumelelo yokwelashwa okunconyiwe lapha.
Baphinde bakhuthaza nodokotela ukuba bacabangele ezinye izimo zesiguli ngesikhathi sokwelashwa.
I-SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV) eyenziwe ngamakhemikhali, i-MERS-CoV kanye ne-SARSr-CoV umuthi wokugoma: Ukuhlaziywa kwekhompyutha okuqhathanisayo ukuze kuphakanyiswe ama-epitope angaba amakhandidethi.

Ama-coronavirus ngokuvamile akhethekile ku-taxonomy yezilwane njengomphathi, izilwane ezincelisayo noma izinyoni kuye ngohlobo lwazo; nokho, lezi zinsalela zingashintsha umphathi ngezinye izikhathi ngenxa yokuguqulwa.

I-HCoV-229E ingenye yama-coronavirus ayisithupha abantu okubalwa kuwo i-HCoV-NL63, i-HCoV-OC43, i-HCoV-HKU1, i-MERS-CoV kanye ne-SARSr-CoV (SARSr-CoV-1 kanye ne-SARS-CoV2) futhi isatshalaliswa emhlabeni wonke.
I-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV-2 zingahlala ezingaphezulu ezingaphili njengezinsimbi, ingilazi noma ipulasitiki kuze kufike ezinsukwini eziyisishiyagalolunye (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Izinyathelo zokuvimbela kanye nokwelashwa ngemithi nge-hydroxychloroquine kuyasiza, kodwa kungase kudingeke umgomo osebenzayo omuhle ukuze kumiswe ukusabalala kobhubhane lwe-covid-19.
Inhloso yocwaningo lwethu kwakuwukuhlonza ama-epitope angaba ngamakhandidethi omuthi wokugoma ngezindlela zebhayofomethi.
Izinto Nezindlela

Uchungechunge oluphelele lwe-genomic lwe-SARS-CoV-2 lutholwe ku-2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) kanye nezinqolobane ezimbili, okuhlanganisa i-National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) kanye ne-TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver yezokuxhumana kwezokwelapha ku-inthanethi.

sizohlinzeka ngombiko omfushane ngemvelaphi yegciwane, siqhathanise idatha yokulandelana ukuze kutholakale izindawo ezigcinwe, indawo yakhe evame kakhulu yephrotheni (indawo yokubopha eqondiwe) kanye nokwakheka kwekhonsensisi ye-motif yomolekyuli engaba yikhethwa (i-epitope) yokuphakanyiswa kwezindlela zokwelapha zesifo esisanda kutholakala i-2019-nCoV, i-SARSr-CoV strain kanye ne-MERS-CoV.
Okuthakazelisayo, ukuqhathaniswa kokulandelana phakathi kwe-SARS-CoV-2 nenye igciwane kuveze ukuthi izinsalela ezikhona kumgomo wokusebenzisana ne-receptor zigcinwa kakhulu nge-70% yobunikazi.
Saxhasa ama-amino acid abalulekile amahlanu (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor kusukela kumaprotheni e-spike anesibopho sokuxhumana phakathi kwegciwane nomphathi.
Kwi-SARS-CoV_ RBD kukhona izinsalela (D480, kanye no-T487) ezivumele ukutheleleka kwezinhlobo ezahlukene.
Nokho, ku-SARS-CoV-2, ukuguqulwa okuncane kwezinye izinsalela kungathuthukisa ukuxhumana nomamukeli weselula yomuntu: L455, F486, Q493, kanye no-N501.
Ku-SARS-CoV, izinsalela ezimbili ezinkulu (479 no-487) zihlotshaniswa nokwaziwa komamukeli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Kwi-SARS-CoV-2, izinsalela ezihambisana no-N479 zihambisana no-Q493 kanti u-T487 uhambisana no-N501.

Sihlonze ukulandelana kwamamino acid agcinwe kahle kumakhontrivayirasi amaningi kuhlanganise ne-2019nCoV nezinye izinhlobo, i-motif ethi KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF itholakale igcinwe kahle kakhulu kulolu cwaningo futhi ihambelana nesifunda esizungeze esinye sezindawo zokuhlukanisa ezaziwayo ze-SARS virus ezikholelwa ukuthi ziyadingeka ukuze i-virus ivuleke ukuze ingene kuseli.

Lo msebenzi wokulandelana kanye nokuhlukahluka okuzungezile kwakha isisekelo sokuphakamisa i-epitope ethile yokugoma yokwenziwa, lokhu okutholakele kungakha amathuba ahlobene nabalingiswa abancane abaqinile kanye nezinto ezihloselwe ukubopha.
