Lolu cwaningo lunikeza ulwazi namathuba okuqinisekisa kwezinto eziphilayo.
Lo msebenzi ungachazwa ngamagama e-bioinformatics, futhi uphindwe kalula abanye, nakuba idatha entsha nocwaningo nge-Covid-19 kuvela futhi kuguquka ngesivinini esikhulu.
Ososayensi baqhathanisa i-Covid-19 namanye amagciwane ahlobene ukuze basize ekutholeni izitofu zokugoma.

NgoSepthemba 2020, ososayensi eMali baqhathanisa ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lwegciwane le-Covid-19 namanye amagciwane e-coronavirus amabili ahlobene kakhulu ukuze bakhombe izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukisweni komgomo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babesafuna imithi yokugoma ye-Covid-19 ephumelelayo.
Babefuna ukuhlonza ukuguqulwa kumgudlu we-Covid-19 okungadlala indima ekutheleleni.
Abacwaningi baseMali ngakho-ke baqhathanisa igciwane le-Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) namanye amagciwane amabili e-coronavirus adala izifo kubantu, okungukuthi i-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV.
Enye yezinhloso eziyinhloko zocwaningo kwakuwukukhomba izindawo ezithile ezisenceliswaneni leCovid-19, ezibizwa ngokuthi ama-epitopes, ezingaqashelwa uhlelo lokuzivikela komzimba womuntu.
Ukubahlonza kungasiza ososayensi ukudala imithi yokugoma esebenza kahle kakhulu.
Abacwaningi baphinde baqhathanisa zonke izinsongo ezintathu ukuze babone ukuthi ngabe kukhona ukufana kofuzo okungasiza ngokuqhubekayo ekuthuthukisweni komgomo.
Bagxila kulayini wezakhi zofuzo wephrotheni ze-spike zamagciwane, okuyiziphrotheni ezibhekele ukusiza amagciwane e-corona ukubopha nokutheleleka kumaseli abantu.
Lokho okutholwe abacwaningi ukuthi amaphrotheni e-spike awo wonke amagciwane amathathu ayefana kakhulu ngokofuzo, ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezisebenzisana namaseli abantu.
Okuvelele ngegciwane le-Covid-19 kwakuwukuthi bekukhona izinguquko ezincane ku-phrotheni ye-spike ezingenza igciwane lisebenze kahle kakhulu ekubophezeleni kumaseli abantu.

Okutholakele kulolu cwaningo kungase kuvumele abanye abacwaningi ukuthi bathuthukise omunye umuthi wokugoma we-Covid-19 osebenzayo ngokubasiza ukuthi bakhombe izindawo ezivamile kumgogodla ezilungele imithi yokugoma.
Ucwaningo luphinde lwanikeza ulwazi olusha mayelana nokufana kanye nokwehluka kofuzo phakathi kwegciwane le-Covid-19 namanye amagciwane e-coronavirus.

Abacwaningi baphawule ukuthi ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni umehluko wezakhi zofuzo egciwaneni le-Covid-19 ulwenza lubhebhetheke kakhulu futhi lube yingozi kakhulu kunezinye izinkanyezi ze-coronavirus.
Izinkinga Zokushaya Kwenhliziyo Okungajwayelekile Kubaguli abane-COVID-19: Ukubuyekezwa Okuhlelekile kanye Nokuhlaziywa KweMeta
I-Cardiac arrhythmia ayinakunganakwa ezigulini ezinesifo se-coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) njengoba inethonya elikhulu emiphumeleni.
Ngakho-ke, lolu cwaningo lwaluhlose ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile mayelana nokwenzeka kwe-cardiac arrhythmia ezigulini ezine-COVID-19.
Senze usesho oluhlelekile lwezizindalwazi ezinokwethenjelwa/izinjini zokusesha ezihlanganisa i-PubMed, i-Scopus, umtapo wolwazi we-Cochrane kanye newebhu yesayensi.
Ngemuva kokuhlola, idatha efanele yakhishwa futhi izigameko ezivela ezifundweni ezihlukene ezihlanganisiwe zahlanganiswa ukuze kwenziwe i-meta-analysis.
Izifundo eziyisishiyagalolunye ekugcineni zafakwa ocwaningweni lwethu oluqukethe iziguli eziyi-1445.
Imiphumela yokuhlaziywa kwe-meta ikhombisile ukuthi izinga lokuphazamiseka kwenhliziyo kubaguli abane-COVID-19 lalingu-19.7% nge-95% yebanga lokuzethemba (CI) elisukela ku-11.7 kuya ku-27.6%.
Kukhona futhi ukuhlukahluka okukhulu (I2□=□94.67%).
Ukungajwayelekile kokushaya kwenhliziyo kwakuvamile kakhulu ezigulini ezine-COVID-19 futhi kwabhekwa ku-19.7% yabo.
Ukugadwa okufanele nge-electrocardiogram ngokuhlonza kahle nangokushesha ama-arrhythmia kubalulekile ekuphathweni okungcono nasekutholakaleni kwemiphumela engcono.
Iziguli eziningi zeCovid-19 zazinenhliziyo eshayayo ngokungajwayelekile.
Abacwaningi bathi cishe oyedwa kwabahlanu babaguli be-Covid-19 babhekana nokuphazamiseka kwezinhliziyo, okwaziwa nangokuthi ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.

Njengoba kujwayelekile, batusa ukuqapha izigqi zenhliziyo zesiguli usebenzisa umshini obizwa nge-electrocardiogram, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukukhomba nokwelapha noma yiziphi izigqi zenhliziyo ezingajwayelekile ngokushesha okukhulu.
Yize i-Covid-19 ithinta amathumbu omoya kanye nesistimu yokuphefumula kakhulu, ucwaningo oluthile lukhombisile ukuthi ingathinta nenhliziyo.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukubuyekeza idatha yeziguli ukuze babone ukuthi izinkinga zenhliziyo ezishaya ngokungajwayelekile zazivame kangakanani ngempela ezigulini ze-Covid-19 ngo-2020, ngasekuqaleni kobhubhane lomhlaba wonke.

Benze i-meta-analysis, okuyindlela lapho abacwaningi behlaziya izifundo eziningi ezahlukene ngesihloko esithile ukuze bazame ukuthola iziphetho ezijwayelekile ezivela kuzo zonke izifundo ezihlanganisiwe.
Bafune izifundo ezihlolwe ontanga abanye abacwaningi kumathala ezincwadi ajwayelekile, bakhipha noma yimaphi amaqatha alwazi ahambelana nokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile ezigulini ze-Covid-19.
Ekugcineni, bafaka izifundo eziyi-9 ezinolwazi mayelana neziguli eziyi-1445.
Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezingu-19.7% ezine-Covid-19 zibonise ukuphazamiseka kokushaya kwenhliziyo.
Baxwayisa nokho ukuthi inani elincane lezifundo abalisebenzisile lingaphazamisa isiphetho sabo.
Ezinye zezifundo azizange zicacise uhlobo oluqondile lwenkinga yenhliziyo, futhi imikhawulo yesifundo ngasinye ingaphazamisa imikhawulo yokuhlaziywa kwazo kwe-meta.
Baphakamisa ukubheka esikhathini esizayo ukuthi kungani iziguli eziningi ezine-Covid-19 zazinezinga lokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.
Ababhali bale phepha babebesuka eGibhithe, nokho iziguli kulesi sifundo zazisuka eChina nase-USA.
Imibono Yezinye Izazi Ngezokufuduka, Ezempilo Yengqondo kanye ne-PTSD:
Ukubuyekezwa Kwemibhalo Efanele
Kulesi sahluko, sinikeza ukubuyekezwa kwezifundo ezibonakalayo ezenziwe nge-PTSD, impilo yengqondo kanye nenhlalakahle yabokufika.
Izifundo eziningi ziphakamisa ukuthi kokubili ukucindezeleka kwangaphambi nangemuva kokufuduka kuthinta impilo yengqondo kanye ne-PTSD yabafuduki kanye nababaleki.
Emazweni lapho bevela khona, ukuvezwa kwezinhlungu nokuhlukunyezwa kubeka izingozi ezinkulu empilweni yengqondo yabokufika.

Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezibangela ukukhathazeka okukhulu kwabokufika emazweni abawamukelayo zihlanganisa ukucindezeleka kokuzivumelanisa nempilo entsha, isimo sezomthetho, ukuhlukaniswa kwemindeni, isithiyo solimi, ukungatholakali kahle kwezinsiza zezempilo ezifanele, ukubandlululwa, ubuhlanga, imizwa yokungabi namandla, ukwehla kokuzethemba, ukucindezeleka okuqhubekayo kanye nokuphapheme ngokweqile.
Phakathi kwazo zonke izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukudangala, ukukhathazeka kanye ne-PTSD kubhekwa njengokujwayelekile kakhulu ngamaphesenti aphakathi kuka-4–40%, 5–44% kanye no-9–36% ngokulandelana.
Ngokuvamile, ukwesekwa komphakathi kanye nezindlela zokuzivumelanisa nezimo kukhonjwe njengezivikelo.
Impilo yengqondo yababaleki ithinteka yisimo abasishiya ngemuva kanye nokuhlala endaweni entsha.
Abokufika nababaleki ababalekela emazweni angaphandle bavame ukubhekana nokucindezeleka okuqhubekayo ngemuva kwesigameko esishaqisayo nezinye izinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenkathi izinkinga eziningi zalezi zidalwa yizinto ezenzeka emazweni abo, ososayensi bathi kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi ukucindezeleka kokuhlala ezweni elisha kunganezela enkingeni.

Ngokwezifundo ezihlukahlukene, ukudangala, ukukhathazeka, kanye nesifo sokucindezeleka ngemuva kwesigameko esishaqisayo (PTSD) kuyizinkinga ezivamile zempilo yengqondo phakathi kwabokufika nababaleki.
I-PTSD imvamisa iyisiphumo sokusinda ezimweni eziyingozi noma ezilimazayo, futhi abantu bavame ukubhekana nemiphumela emibi yalezo zehlakalo ezingezinhle izinyanga, noma ngisho iminyaka.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda izici ezahlukene ezidlala indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo zabokufika ezifana ne-PTSD.

Ngakho-ke benza uhlobo locwaningo olubizwa ngokuthi ukubuyekeza, lapho behlola khona ulwazi oluvela kwezinye izifundo eziningi ezihlobene nalesi sihloko, ukuze bathole ukuthambekela noma izindikimba ezivamile.
Ezimweni eziningi, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zabokufika zaziyisiphumo sezehlakalo ezinzima ezifana nempi, ukulahlekelwa abathandekayo, noma ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzimba okwakwenzeka emazweni abo.
Ngenkathi laba bantu beshiya lezo zimo, babhekana nohambo olunzima kodwa bazizwa bekhululekile lapho befika ezweni elisha.
Abacwaningi bathe, nokho, lokhu kukhululeka kwakuvame ukuba kwesikhashana, ngoba abokufika babhekana nezinselelo ezintsha ngemva kokuthuthela kwenye indawo.
Bathole ukuthi abokufika bavame ukuba nesikhathi esinzima ezweni elisha futhi, ikakhulukazi uma bengayiqondi ulimi, noma behluleka ukujwayela isiko.
Uma abantu befike ezweni ngokungemthetho, noma bezama ukuthola indawo yokukhosela, baphinde babhekane nezinkinga zomthetho, futhi kaningi babenesikhathi esinzima sokuthola izinsiza ezifana nezempilo.
Kwabanye, ubuhlanga nokucwasa ezweni labo elisha kwengeza emizweni yabo yokungaphephile, futhi abaningi babeshiyile amalungu omndeni emuva futhi babedwa.
Lezi zinto zibe nomthelela ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo eziqhubekayo, ngisho noma laba bafuduki sebephakathi kwesimo esiphephile kunaleso esikhona ezweni labo.

Abacwaningi baphinde bathi abokufika babenamasu amaningi ahlukene okulungisa lezi zinkinga, kusukela ekuhleleni ngokucophelela ukuthi bangazibhekana kanjani nazo, kuya ekufuneni usizo kwabanye emphakathini wabo, noma izindlela ezingezinhle ezifana nokusebenzisa kabi izidakamizwa.
Abacwaningi bathi kudingeka olunye ucwaningo ezigabeni zonke zohambo lwabokufika.
Kubalulekile ngokukhethekile ukuhlola izici ezithinta impilo yengqondo emazweni abantu abakhulele kuwo, kodwa futhi nangesikhathi eside emazweni abo amasha.
Banezela ukuthi izinkambo zabantu abathuthela e-Europe bevela e-Afrika zidinga ukunakwa okwengeziwe kubacwaningi.

Lolu cwaningo bekuyisebenziswano phakathi kososayensi abazinze eNingizimu Afrika naseJalimane, futhi luyingxenye yencwadi emayelana nezinto ezihlangabezwana nazo ngabafuduki base-Afrika abahlala emazweni aseYurophu.
Ukuba khona kanye nokuqhubeka kwe-Amblyomma Hebraeum kwandisa umthwalo we-Heartwater esifundeni esiseningizimu yeBotswana.
I-Heartwater yisifo esithwalwa yizimbungulu, esihlasela igazi esinethuba lokunciphisa ukukhula kwamabhizinisi ezolimo eBotswana.
Lesi sisongo ekuphepheni kokudla kuzwelonke sibangelwa ukukhiqizwa okuphansi nokufa kwezinkomo ekufuyweni kwezinkomo ezincane ekufuyweni kokuziphilisa kunezifama zokuhweba.
Lolu cwaningo lunikeza umbono ngomthwalo we-epidemiological we-heartwater eBotswana.
Ukondla omakhalanjalo ezilwaneni ezifuywayo ezigcinwe ezindaweni ezine ezisezansi kwezigodi zaseBotswana kwakhonjwa ngokuhlaziywa kwesimo nokuhlaziywa kwezakhi zofuzo.
Abalimi babuzwa imibuzo mayelana nokuphathwa komthwalo we-heartwater ngaphakathi kwezifunda zabo ezingaphansi.
Izibalo zamacala ezokwelapha izilwane zaqoqwa ukuze kuhlolwe imvamisa yamacala esifundeni esiseNingizimu yeBotswana.

Imiphumela yocwaningo iveze; ukusabalala okubanzi kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izifunda eziyisihlanu ezifundwe, ukukhuphuka konyaka kancane kwecala le-heartwater esifundeni esincane saseMoshupa kanye nenkomba yokwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zezimbuzi zomdabu naphezu kwemizamo yokulawula izithwali ngamaphesenti angama-63 wabafuyi abaxoxiswane nabo.

I-Amblyomma hebraeum, okuyiyona ehamba phambili yokuthwala i-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu Afrika isakazeke kabanzi eSifundeni esiseNingizimu yeBotswana futhi ngaleyo ndlela ibeka inselele ekukhiqizeni kwezinkomo kulesi sifunda, futhi mhlawumbe, nakwezinye izindawo ezweni lapho ixoxo lihlupha khona izinkomo.
Kukhona-ke isidingo sokuhlola kabusha izindlela zokulawula omiyane ezikhona ngenhloso yokunciphisa umthwalo wesifo se-heartwater ikakhulukazi ezimvini nasezimbuzini.
Inani eliphezulu lama-tick eningizimu yeBotswana libhebhethekisa isifo se-heartwater ezifuyweni.
Lolu cwaningo lubika ngomthwalo osabalele wezilokazane nesifo senhliziyo enamanzi eningizimu yeBotswana phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Imiphumela yocwaningo ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukwenza izinhlelo zokulawula kangcono isifo se-heartwater.
Amanye amabhaktheriya athwalwa yizibungu abizwa ngokuthi i-Ehrlichia ruminantium, abanga isifo esaziwa ngokuthi i-heartwater ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini.
Le bhaktheriya iyisiphilayo esiphila ngokudla ezinye izidalwa eziphilayo njengemfuyo, okubenza balimale.
Izilwane eziphila nezifo zenhliziyo ngokuvamile ziba nezinga lokushisa komzimba eliphezulu, zilahlekelwe isifiso sokudla, zibe nezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi ekugcineni zingase zife.
I-Heartwater ivamile kakhulu engxenyeni eseningizimu yeBotswana, futhi abalimi bakuleyo ndawo balahlekelwa izilwane zabo ngenxa yalolu bhubhane.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baphenye umthwalo we-heartwater eningizimu yeBotswana.
Baqale baqoqa, babala futhi bakhombe omakhalanyosi abatholakala ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzini ukuze baqhathanise inani lomakhalanyosi abathwele igciwane le-heartwater nabanye omakhalanyosi.
Abacwaningi baphinde baxoxisana nabanye abalimi mayelana nolwazi lwabo nge-heartwater, futhi baqoqa eminye imibiko ye-heartwater ehhovisi lezokwelapha izilwane (impilo yezilwane).
Abacwaningi bathi omakhalane abalimazayo basakazeke kabanzi endaweni yocwaningo, futhi inani lamacala esifo senhliziyo likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka.
Baqoqa omagciwane abayi-310 phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Bathole izinhlobo ezi-3 zomkhaza: umkhaza waseNingizimu Afrika obizwa ngokuthi i-bont tick, umkhaza onemilenze ebizwa ngokuthi i-bont-legged tick, kanye nomkhaza omnyama wenja.
Okuyinto evamile kakhulu kwakuyi-South African bont tick (85%), futhi lena yiyo ethwala amagciwane adala isifo senhliziyo samanzi.

Ezinye izinhlobo ezi-2 zomkhaza abazikhombe azifaki isandla ekuguleni kwe-heartwater, kodwa zixhumene nezinye izifo zezilwane ezifuywayo ezifana ne-'theileriosis', 'anaplasmosis' kanye ne-'babesiosis'.
Indawo ecwaningwe abacwaningi yayihlanganisa iGoodhope, iKanye, iMoshupa, neJwaneng.
Omihlwa babebuningi eGoodhope, eKanye naseMoshupa.
Lezi zindawo zazimanzi kakhulu, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
Jwaneng, eyayinezinhlava ezincane kunazo zonke, yayomile, inesihlabathi futhi inezitshalo ezincane.
Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi ezokwelapha izilwane aveze amacala angu-42 e-heartwater e-Goodhope, angu-38 e-Jwaneng, angu-75 e-Kanye, kanye angu-146 e-Moshupa, kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019.
Abacwaningi bathe isifo senhliziyo samanzi sithinta izimbuzi nezinkomo zendawo kakhulu kunezinhlobo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.
Bathi abalimi benza imizamo ethile yokulawula omatheka.
Isibonelo, u-63% wabalimi bacwilisa izilwane emikhiqizweni yokubulala izinambuzane (amakhemikhali asetshenziswa ukubulala izinambuzane ezifana nezimfece).
Cishe ingxenye eyodwa kwezintathu (30%) yabalimi bafaka amafutha ezilwaneni zabo ukulawula omiyane, kanti abanye (7%) bakhethe ukwakha izibaya ezintsha.

Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi u-44% wabafuyi abenzanga lutho ukubhekana nesilwane esisolwa ukuthi siyagula, kanti u-15% wathi bazovakashela izikhulu zezokwelapha izilwane ukuze bathole izeluleko, kodwa banika izilwane imithi ngokwabo.
Yize kwakukhona umuthi wokugoma otholakalayo ukuvimbela isifo se-heartwater, abacwaningi bathi u-93% wabafuyi awuzange uwusebenzise.
Abalimi batshela abacwaningi ukuthi kwakungenxa yokuthi babengafundisiwe ngegciwane, futhi ngenxa yokuthi bebengakwazi ukukhokhela umgomo.

Ezinye izifundo esikhathini esidlule zabheka ukuthi omagciwane basakazwa kanjani e-Afrika, kuhlanganise neBotswana, kodwa ngokusho kwabacwaningi, eyabo yayiyokuqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwamagciwane nezimo ze-heartwater eBotswana.

Bathi amacala e-heartwater aqoshwe odokotela bezilwane kungenzeka abe mancane kunamacala empeleni abhekene nawo abalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola isifo se-heartwater kuphela uma isilwane sesifile, okusho ukuthi izilwane eziphila nesifo noma izilwane ezilulame azihlali zibalwa.
Abacwaningi batusa ukuthi abalimi kufanele bafundiswe ukuthi bangayilawula kanjani futhi bayiphathe kanjani i-heartwater disease ezifuyweni zabo, ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo wayo endaweni.
Baphinde bathi kumele kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuze kutholakale izici eziholela ekuchumeni kwamathikithi.
Abacwaningi babesesekelwe eBotswana.
Izinselele Ekutheni Kwenziwe Ukuhlolwa Kwesikhungo Sokunakekela eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika

Ukuhlolwa kwe-Point of Care (POC) emiphakathini, ezindaweni zasekhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo kukholakala ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu okunciphisa ukubambezeleka ekutholeni nasekuqaleni ukwelashwa kwezifo ezifana ne-HIV, isifo sofuba, isifo sofuba kanye nomalaleveva.

Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo kanye nezinqumo zokuphatha ezengeziwe eziqediwe engqungqutheleni efanayo yezokwelapha noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngenkathi isiguli silindile, kunethemba lokunqoba ukubambezeleka okuhlotshaniswa nokuhlolwa okujwayelekile okususelwe elabhorethri.
Nokho, ukutholakala kwezivivinyo ezishibhile, ezilula, nezisheshayo ezingaqhutshwa ngaphandle kwamalabhorethri akuqinisekisi ngempumelelo ukuhlolwa kwe-POC.

Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselele amadivayisi ezokwelapha afana nalawa ahlangabezana nazo, sidinga ukufunda ukuthi izindlela zokuhlola zisetshenziswa kanjani e-POC futhi zihlanganiswe kanjani emsebenzini nasezindleleni zokulashwa kweziguli.
Lesi sahluko sibuyekeza imiphumela ekhethiwe evela kuphrojekthi yocwaningo lwekhwalithethivu mayelana nezithiyo zokuhlolwa kwe-POC eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika futhi uyaxoxa ngazo ngokufanisa.

Iphrojekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingahlelekile ngokuphelele kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu agxile ekuhloleni izindlela zokuxilonga ezibhekene nezifo ezinkulu kanye nabalingisi emakhaya, emitholampilo, emiphakathini, ezibhedlela, nasemalabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ekuthelekiseni imiphumela ekhethiwe, kuyacaca ukuthi zombili izizwe zinezinhlaka ezihlukahlukene zokuhlola ezihlinzeka ngezimo ezihlukile zokuhlolwa kwe-POC.
Isahluko siqeda ngokucabangela ukuthi ungawasebenzisa kanjani la maqiniso uma uhlela izinhlelo zokuhlola i-POC.
Ukungahambi kahle kokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kubambezela ukunakekelwa kwezempilo.
I-Point-of-care (POC) ibhekisela ezivivinyweni zezempilo ezenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isiguli sithola khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuthi kuthunyelwe izampula zesiguli kude nelabhorethri ukuze zihlolwe.
INingizimu Afrika neNdiya azilethi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokusebenzayo ngenxa yezinhlelo zabo ze-POC ezimbi namalabhorethri.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuba zithole ukufinyelela ekuhlolweni okusheshayo nemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini eshibhile futhi elula enganikeza imiphumela yokuhlola ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthatha amasampula ayiswa ema-labhorethri.
Kodwa kunezinselele eziningi ku-POC ezinciphisa ukunakekelwa kweziguli eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ababhali babefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya ukuze bakwazi ukukhomba izinkinga.
Benza izingxoxo kanye nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zemishini yezokwelapha kusukela ngoSepthemba, 2012, kuya kuJuni, 2013, emazweni womabili.
Babebuza ngemigudu ye-POC nezinkinga.

Empilweni yomphakathi, i-India isebenzisa amalabhorethri amancane amaningi futhi yenza izivivinyo eziyisisekelo, kodwa amalabhorethri awo awatholi imali eyanele, ngakho awanazo izinto ezanele zokwenza izivivinyo.
Iziguli zivame ukutshelwa ukuthi zibuye ngelinye ilanga noma ziye kwenye indawo, okudala izinkinga ezigulini.
Abacwaningi baphinde baqaphela ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi iziguli ziyahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi imiphumela ibuye, futhi zithola kunzima ukuxhumana nodokotela wazo ngemuva kwalokho.
Ababambiqhaza bathe kufanele kube namalabhorethri amaningi ezibhedlela, futhi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho iziguli zingena khona.
Baphinde bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi emitholampilo yomphakathi, inkampani eyodwa iphethe yonke imisebenzi yokuhlola, ngakho amasampula aya kule nkampani.
Ezinye izivivinyo eziyisisekelo zenziwa endaweni yokunakekelwa, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Izivivinyo ze-HIV ne-TB zithatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke ukuqhutshekelwa phambili noma ukwelashwa nakho kubambezeleka.
Ezinye izinkinga zibangelwa wukuhamba, ukupelwa okungalungile kwamagama eziguli, ukulebula okungafanele kwamasampuli, kanye nokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha.
Ngokuhlola i-HIV, amanye amalabhorethri asebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engathembekile.

Bathola ukuthi iziguli zizama ukuthola ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ngokusekelwe ebangeni lesiza noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokhu kwesinye isikhathi zisebenzisa ikhadi lokuzazisa elihlukile, okudala izinkinga uma kuzanywa ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Abacwaningi baphakamisile ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze babelane ngomthwalo womsebenzi.
Bathi uma kufika amakhithi amasha okuhlola i-HIV, abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi izinhlelo kufanele zibuyekezwe.
Ababhali baqhathanise idatha ye-POC evela emazweni womabili futhi baphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kumele zibheke i-POC kahle ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo noma amadivayisi amasha.
Baphinde bathi kudingeka ukufakwa imizamo eminingi ekubhekaneni nomthwalo womsebenzi kumalabhorethri kanye nokuqonda indima edlalwa isiguli ekunakekelweni kwaso kwezempilo.
Ababhali baleli phepha babengabaseNingizimu Afrika, India, Canada kanye neNetherlands.
Ngasekutholeni izincazelo zokugula okukhulu nokunakekelwa okukhulu kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziywa kwemibono.

Njengoba "ukugula okukhulu" kanye "nokunakekelwa okukhulu" kungekho izincazelo ezivumelanisiwe, lolu cwaningo luhlose ukuhlola ukuthi le mibono isetshenziswa kanjani, ichaze izici ezichazayo futhi iphakamise izincazelo ezingaba khona.
Sisebenzise indlela yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo ka-Walker no-Avant ekuhlaziyeni umqondo.
Ukusetshenziswa kanye nezincazelo zemibono kwakhonjwa ngokubuyekezwa kokuhlola imibhalo kanye nenhlolovo eku-inthanethi yo-114 yochwepheshe bezokwelapha emhlabeni wonke.
Ngokuhlaziywa kokuqukethwe kwedatha sathola amakhodi, izigaba nezindikimba ukuze sinqume izimfanelo ezichazayo zemibono futhi saphakamisa izincazelo ezingaba khona.
Ukuze kusizwe ukuqonda, sethula imodeli, izimo ezihlobene neziphikisanayo maqondana nemibono, sikhombe izandulela nemiphumela emibonweni, futhi sachaza izinkomba ezibonakalayo.
Izici ezichazayo zokugula okukhulu kwakuyingozi enkulu yokufa okuseduze; ukuphazamiseka kwezitho ezibalulekile zomzimba; isidingo sokunakekelwa ukuvimbela ukufa; kanye nokwenzeka kokuphindeka.

Izici ezichazayo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile kwakuwukuhlonza, ukuqapha nokwelapha ukugula okukhulu; ukwesekwa kwezitho ezibalulekile; ukunakekelwa kokuqala nokuqhubekayo; noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kokugula okukhulu; kanye nezinsiza ezikhethekile zomuntu nezomzimba.

Inkcazelo yethu ephakanyisiwe yokugula okukhulu ithi, "isimo sokungaphili kahle okunokuphazamiseka kwemisebenzi yezitho ezibalulekile zomzimba, ingozi enkulu yokufa okuseduze uma ukunakekelwa kungahlinzekwanga kanye namathuba okuguqulwa."

Ingcazelo yethu ehlongozwayo yokunakekelwa okubalulekile ithi, "ukukhonjwa, ukuqapha kanye nokwelashwa kweziguli ezinesifo esibucayi ngokusekelwa kokuqala nokuqhubekayo kwemisebenzi yezitho ezibalulekile zomzimba."
Imiqondo yokugula okukhulu kanye nokunakekelwa okukhulu ayinazo izincazelo ezivunyelwene ngazo futhi inezindlela ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa.

Ngokuhlaziya imiqondo yokusetshenziswa nezincazelo ezincwadini nasezikhulwini, sikhombe izimfanelo ezichazayo zemiqondo futhi siphakamisa izincazelo ezingasiza ekusebenzeni kwezokwelapha, ucwaningo, kanye nokwenza izinqumo zenqubomgomo.
Amandla kanye Nezingqinamba Zocwaningo
Lolu hlaziyo lombono luyisifundo sokuqala ukuchaza ngokuhlelekile ukusetshenziswa nezincazelo zemibono yokugula okukhulu nokunakekelwa okukhulu.

Ucwaningo lusebenzisa ukubuyekezwa kwesifunda kwezincwadi kanye nemibono evela kochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangaphezu kwekhulu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni jikelele ukuze kutholakale izimfanelo ezichazayo futhi kunikezwe izincazelo ezihlongozwayo zemibono.

Ezinye izindlela zokusebenzisa kanye nezincazelo zemibono ezilimini ngaphandle kwesiNgisi, ezincwadini ezingashicilelwe ezimpunga kanye nochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangafakiwe ocwaningweni kungenzeka ziye zaphuthelwa.
Njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwemibono kuhluke kakhulu, izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe kungenzeka zingamukelwa yibo bonke futhi zihloselwe ukuvuselela ingxoxo eyengeziwe.
Abacwaningi baphinde bachaza kabusha incazelo yeziguli “ezigula kakhulu” kanye nokunakekelwa kwazo.
Izincazelo ezijwayelekile zokunakekela iziguli ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke ngabo bonke odokotela zingasiza ekunakekeleni iziguli ezigula kakhulu.
Kulesi sifundo, ithimba labacwaningi bamazwe ngamazwe liphakamisa ukuthi "ukugula okukhulu" kufanele kusho ukuthi ngenkathi isiguli esigulayo sinamathuba aphezulu okufa, singaphinde siphile.
Baphinde bathi “ukunakekelwa” okunikezwa iziguli ezigula kakhulu kufanele kusho noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa okunikezwa kusukela ngesikhathi befika esibhedlela, kuze kube yilapho befa noma belulama.
Akufanele futhi kubhekisele kuphela ekunakekeleni kusetshenziswa imishini ekhethekile.
Ezibhedlela, odokotela bavame ukubiza iziguli ezigula kakhulu ngokuthi “zigula kakhulu”, kanti ukunakekelwa nokusekelwa okudingwa yilezi ziguli kubizwa ngokuthi “ukunakekela okukhulu”.
Nokho, odokotela abasebenza ezifundeni ezahlukene noma ezibhedlela baqonda le migomo ngokuhlukile, ngoba izincazelo zabo ziyahlukahluka ukusuka kwenye indawo kuya kwenye.
Lokhu kuholela, isibonelo, ekutheni iziguli ezinesimo esifanayo zithole ukwelashwa noma ukunakekelwa okuhlukile, kuye ngokuthi ubani obasizayo.
Izincazelo ezihlukene zenza kube nzima kuhulumeni ukwazi inani langempela lezifo ezibucayi ezweni labo.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baqala ngokuhlaziya ukuthi odokotela abahlukene bachaza kanjani "ukugula okukhulu" kanye "nokunakekelwa okukhulu", bese behlongoza izincazelo ezijwayelekile.
Baqoqa ulwazi ngokubuyekeza ezinye izihloko ezishicilelwe.
Baphinde baxoxisana nodokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa ahlukene emhlabeni ababenolwazi lokwelapha iziguli ezigula kakhulu.

Abacwaningi babhala phansi izincazelo ezihlukene zezifo ezibucayi, futhi baphawula ukuthi ngokujwayelekile zazihlotshaniswa nethuba eliphezulu lokuthi iziguli zife; ezinye izingxenye zomzimba zingasebenzi; isidingo sokunakekelwa ukuze kugwemeke ukufa; kanye namathuba okululama.
Ngodaba lokufa nokululama, ezinye izincazelo zisho ukuthi bonke abagula kakhulu bazogcina ngokufa, kanti ezinye zisho ukuthi kunethuba lokuthi isiguli sizolulama naphezu kokugula kakhulu.

Ekugcineni, abacwaningi baphakamise ukuchaza ukugula okukhulu njengokugula lapho izitho zomzimba ziyeka ukusebenza, lapho kunethuba eliphezulu lokuthi isiguli singafa uma singanakekelwa kahle, kodwa nethuba lokululama.
Kwesokunakekelwa okubalulekile, odokotela babonakala bekuchaza ngendlela efanayo, kodwa bahluke mayelana nokuthi ukunakekelwa okunjalo kufanele kunikezwe kuphi, kanye nesidingo semishini ekhethekile.
Ezinye izinsiza zathi ukunakekelwa okubucayi kunganikezwa kuphela ezindaweni ezikhethekile esibhedlela ezinempahla ekhethekile.
Abanye babecabanga ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubucayi kungase kuhlanganise ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, kodwa bekungeyona imfuneko.
Bathi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kunganikezwa ngisho nasemawadini ajwayelekile, ezikhungweni zezempilo ezincane, emphakathini noma emalolini ezinsiza kashukela.
Bathi ngisho nasezindaweni ezihluphekayo, iziguli ezigula kakhulu zidinga ukunakekelwa okubucayi.

Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungachazwa njengakho konke ukunakekelwa okutholwa iziguli ezinesifo esibucayi kusukela ngesikhathi zivakashela abasebenzi bezempilo ukuze zicele iseluleko kuze kube isikhathi sokufa noma sokululama.
Abacwaningi bathi lolu bekungucwaningo lokuqala oluqoqe ulwazi ngencazelo ehlukene yesifo esibucayi nokunakekelwa, futhi imiphumela yabo izosiza ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abagula kakhulu.
Nokho bathi ucwaningo lwabo lungase lukhawulelwe iqiniso lokuthi abazange basebenzise izincazelo ezivela kwezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi noma ezivela emithonjeni engashicilelwe.
Baphinde baxoxisana nodokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziya kwabo akumele wonke amazwe emhlabeni.
Abacwaningi, abavela emayunivesithi aseMalawi, eTanzania, eSweden nase-UK, bathe izincazelo zabo eziphakanyisiwe zingaguqulwa kakhulu uma kudingeka.
Isikrini se-CRISPR-Cas9 esibanzi se-genome sikhomba i-CENPJ njengomlawuli wokusingatha wohlelo lwe-microtubule oluguqukile ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kwePlasmodium esibindini.
Ngaphambi kokuqala umalaleveva onezimpawu, i-Plasmodium sporozoite eyodwa itheleka ku-hepatocyte bese ithuthuka ibe izinkulungwane zama-merozoite, ngokwengxenye ngokusebenzisa izinsiza zomphathi.
Sikhombisa ukuthi ama-microtubule omphathi ahlelwa kabusha ngenkuthalo azungeze isilonda esithuthukayo sesiteji se-liver (LS) se-parasite.

Sisebenzisa isikrini se-CRISPR-Cas9 esibanzi ku-genome, sikhombe abalawuli besihostela sokuhlelwa kwe-cytoskeleton, ukuhamba kwe-vesicle, ukucindezeleka kwe-ER/Golgi kanye nokwakhiwa kwamafutha alawula ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Plasmodium LS.
Laba balawuli abasha bokutheleleka, okuhlanganisa neCentromere Protein J (CENPJ), basiholele ekubuzeni ukuthi izikhungo ezihlela i-microtubule (MTOCs) zilawulwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
Amafoci e-γ-tubulin atholakala emaphethelweni omkhaza; ukwehla kwe-CENPJ kwandisa lokhu kuthuthela kabusha futhi kwandisa ukutheleleka.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sikhombisa ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-MTOC engeyona ye-centrosomal ngokuhlela i-γ-tubulin nokukhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-microtubule emaphethelweni esilwane esincane.

Ngokuhlanganyela, sikhombisa ukuthi i-Plasmodium LS iqasha i-Golgi yomphathi ukuze yakhe iziteshi eziphakathi nendawo eziholwa yi-MT lapho izitho zomzimba zomphathi ziqashwa ku-PVM, ukusekela ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba sezinso.
Okutholakele kwethu kusikisela ukuthi abaningi abavimbeli bezidakamizwa abahlosiwe bangavimbela ukutheleleka kwe-LS.
Ososayensi bafunda indlela i-malaria ehlasela ngayo amaseli ukuzama ukunweba izinketho zokwelapha.
Izimbungulu eziningi zisebenzisa izakhamzimba nezinsiza zamaseli omzimba womuntu noma wesilwane wazo ukuze ziziphindaphinde.
Kulesi sifundo abacwaningi bakhombe amajini athile adlala indima ekuthelelekeni kwe-malaria kumaseli esibindi, okungaholela ekuqondeni izidakamizwa ezintsha ezilwa ne-malaria esikhathini esizayo.
IMalaria yisifo esivamile futhi esingase sibulale esibangelwa ipharasayithi i-Plasmodium, edluliselwa ngokulunywa yizinambuzane.

Uma engena emzimbeni, i-Plasmodium iya ngqo esibindini ukuzokhiqiza - lesi sigaba sokuqala sifaneleka kakhulu ekwelapheni umalaleveva ngoba azikho izimpawu zesifo okwamanje futhi lesi sifo asikwazi ukusabalala.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuthola izinguquko ezithile kuma-gene kanye nama-phrotheni kumaseli esibindi athelelekile angashintsha ukuthi ukutholakala kwalesi sifo kuthuthuka kanjani.
Sebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuhlela amagciwane i-CRISPR-Cas9, abacwaningi bakwazile ukuvala noma “ukukhupha” amagciwane athile ukuze babone ukuthi yini eshintsha lapho lawo magciwane engasebenzi.
Bese begcina betheleka kokubili amaseli esibindi ajwayelekile kanye nalawo aphumile ngezinambuzane ze-malaria.
Lezi zakhiwo ezifana netyhubhu zihileleke kokunye, ekuhambeni kwezinto zokudla nezinto ngaphakathi kwamangqamuzana, futhi ngokuvamile zakha inethiwekhi ezungeze uqanda lweseli.

Omunye wotholakele okubalulekile ukuthi i-Plasmodium ithatha ama-microtubules kumaseli esibindi - esikhundleni sokuthi ama-microtubules ahlangane azungeze inucleus aletha izakhamzimba nezinto lapho iseli idinga khona, ama-microtubules ahlangane azungeze isilokazane aletha izakhamzimba nezinto ukusiza isilokazane sizale.

Abacwaningi babone ukuthi lapho beqeda iphrotheni ebizwa nge-CENPJ, iparasayithi yaba yimpumelelo enkulu ekuqoqeni ama-microtubules azungeze yona, futhi amapherasayithi akhula aba makhulu futhi enza amakhophi amaningi azo.
Ososayensi baphinde bakhombe amanye amajini amaningi athinta ukuthi ukuhlaselwa yi-plasmodium kuba kubi kangakanani.
Abacwaningi phambilini bakhombisa ukuthi ezinye izimbungulu zihlela kabusha ama-microtubules ukuze ziqondise kabusha izinsiza ngaphakathi kweseli kuzo.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi amaprasayithi e-Plasmodium angasebenzisa leli qhinga ukuhambisela kabusha izakhamzimba nezinye izinsiza ekuthuthukiseni kwawo.
Esikhathini esizayo, ososayensi banethemba lokusebenzisa ukuqonda kwabo kokuthi amajini nezilokazane zisebenzisana kanjani ngaphakathi kwamangqamuzana ukuze bathole ukwelashwa okusha kwe-malaria.

Yize abacwaningi bekhombe ezinye izinguquko ezithakazelisayo kumaprotheni amaseli esibindi ezigabeni zokuqala zesifo se-malaria, kusekuningi okudingekayo ukuze kuqondwe kahle ukuthi i-Plasmodium ishintsha kanjani i-chemistry kanye nomsebenzi weseli ukuze kuhlonzwe izindawo ezithile ezihlosiwe zamakhambi.
Amakhulu ezinkulungwane zokufa zisenzeka minyaka yonke ngenxa ye-malaria, inani elikhulu lalezi zenzeka e-Afrika.

Ngokwe-World Health Organisation, ngaphezu kuka-90% wamacala omalaleveva emhlabeni jikelele ngo-2019 enzeka e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube udaba olubalulekile oludinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulawula nokungenelela.
Ukungenelela Kwezinto Ezibukhoma Njengengxenye Yomzamo Wokucwaninga Ngokushintsha Komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika
Kulesi sahluko, sihlola ukuthi ucwaningo oluningi kangakanani eNingizimu Afrika olubheke ekuhlaselweni kwezinto eziphilayo uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izici zoshintsho lomhlaba wonke.

Sisebenzisa i-Web of Science, sabuyekeza ngokuhlelekile imibhalo ehambisana nezinhlelo zemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika eshicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 futhi ephathelene nokuhlasela kwezinto eziphilayo, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuvunwa ngokweqile, ukuguqulwa kwehabitat, ukungcola, kanye/noma i-CO2 emkhathini.
Sikhombe amaphepha afanele angu-1149 abalwa ngokwezinga lokugubha kwawo izimbangela kanye nokusebenzisana kwezimbangela ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem.
Umphumela oqinile wesikhala nesikhathi wabonwa emzamweni wocwaningo.

Okokuqala, umzamo wawuhluka phakathi kwezindawo, ukuguqulwa kwehabitat, ukungcola kanye nokuvuna ngokweqile kuthola ugxile olukhulu ocwaningweni ngaphakathi kwezindawo zomhlaba, amanzi ahlanzekile kanye nezindawo zasolwandle/zase-estuarine ngokulandelana.
Okwesibili, ezinye izenzakalo ezaziwa kahle emhlabeni jikelele azizange zibhaliwe ezincwadini zendawo (isb. bekukhona amaphepha angaphansi kwayisihlanu ngokuncibilika kwamazinga olwandle).

Sihlonze ukusebenzelana okuhlukene okungu-21 phakathi kwabashayeli, nokusebenzelana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kanye noshintsho lwendawo yokuhlala (isibonelo izinguquko ezinhlelweni zomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselwe) kube okugqamile kakhulu.
Nokho, ngaphansi kuka-4% wezincwadi ezibhekane nokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.

Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi nakuba ukubaluleka kokuqonda ukusebenzelana kwabashayeli kuvunyelwe, kube kuncane okwenziwe ocwaningweni ngemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzelana kwabashayeli ezinhlelweni zezemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Isitatimende esidala esithi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo zibeka usongo lwesibili olukhulu ekongiweni kwezinhlobonhlobo zemvelo, ngemuva koshintsho lwendawo yokuhlala, sifanisa umphumela wocwaningo oluhlobene nalomshayeli eNingizimu Afrika.

Ukuthuthukisa isithombe esiphelele esilinganiselwe sokubaluleka okuhlobene kwabashayeli bokuguquka komhlaba kuzoba yinselelo, hhayi kuphela ekuchazeni ngokucacile abashayeli, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokungalingani kokutholakala kwemiphumela yocwaningo ezikalini zesikhala nesikhathi ezifanayo.
Ubukhulu bokuvuthwa komsebenzi ngezinto ezihlaselayo kungahlinzeka ngesisekelo sokuhlola ukuxhumana okuyinkimbinkimbi okunjalo futhi ngaleyo ndlela kube negalelo ekunqobeni izithiyo ezinjalo.
Abacwaningi kumele babhale imephu yemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yezinhlobo ezihlaselayo, ushintsho lwezulu kanye nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

Izinhlobo zezilwane ezihlaselayo ziyingozi yesibili ngobukhulu ekuvikelweni kokuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elifaniswa, kusho abacwaningi, ngenani lamaphepha ocwaningo enziwe ngalesi sihloko.
Lokhu kuhlobene nezinye izinsongo ezifana nokungcoliswa kwemvelo, ukuguquka kwesimo sezulu, ukuvunwa ngokweqile noma izinguquko endaweni yokuhlala.

Lezi zisongelo ezimiseleni zemvelo yizo ezibizwa ososayensi ngokuthi izimbangela zokuguquka komhlaba, okuwucwaningo lokuthi uMhlaba, njengohlelo, ushintsha kanjani nazo zonke izindlela zokuxhumana phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu nezinye izinqubo zomzimba, zamakhemikhali nezomzimba.

Esahlukweni sencwadi yakamuva, abacwaningi babheka ukuthi ucwaningo oluningi lwenziwa kangakanani eNingizimu Afrika mayelana nokuhlasela kwezemvelo, okuyilapho izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo noma izilwane zethulwa endaweni entsha lapho zihluma khona, zisunguleke futhi mhlawumbe zilimaze ezinye izinhlobo ezizungezile noma imvelo.
Baphinde babheka ucwaningo ngokuthi lo mshayela uxhumana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.
Bheka emaphepheni ocwaningo ashicilelwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kudathabheyisi ye-“Web of Science”, bathole izifundo eziyi-1149 ezihambisanayo.

Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kwezifundo kwabonisa ukuthi ucwaningo olusekelwe emhlabeni (terrestrial) lwagxila kakhulu ekushintsheni kwehabitat, kanti ucwaningo lwamanzi ahlanzekile lwagxila ekungcolisweni, futhi ucwaningo olwandle nasezindaweni zokuhlangana kwamanzi lwalugxile kakhulu ekutheni kuvunwa ngokweqile.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi izimo ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ezithinta ukuhlukahluka kwezinto eziphilayo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle ezifundweni zasendaweni zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Isibonelo, bathole kuphela amaphepha ama-5 abheka ukuncibilika kwamazulu olwandle, okuphazamisa izixhumanisi zokudla futhi kulimaza impilo yasolwandle.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-carbon dioxide engaphezulu emkhathini, evela emisebenzini yabantu efana nokushiswa kwamafutha ezinto eziphilayo, iyancibilika emanzini olwandle.
Izinguquko zemvelo, ezifana nezomlilo noma izinguquko zesimo sezulu, ziholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Bathi i-carbon dioxide inyuke cishe ngo-40%, futhi kungase kudale izimo ezingcono zokuthi izitshalo zangaphandle zikhule.
Kodwa, kunocwaningo oluncane kakhulu olwenziwe ngalesi sihloko eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathole amaphepha angama-21 abheka ukuthi abashayeli abahlukene baxhumana kanjani.
Iningi lalokhu ligxile ekuhlobaneni kwezinguquko zendawo yokuhlala nezilwane ezihlaselayo.
Kodwa, amaphepha ambalwa kakhulu abheka abashayeli abangu-3 noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esisodwa.
Ababhali bathi lokhu kusikisela ukuthi kudingeka ucwaningo olwengeziwe mayelana nokuthi izishayeli zoshintsho lomhlaba wonke zisebenzisana kanjani ukuthinta izinhlelo zemvelo eNingizimu Afrika.

Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika bayavuma ukuthi kuzoba nzima ukuthuthukisa isithombe esiphelele sokuthi izishayeli zokuguquka komhlaba zisebenzisana kanjani eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa bathi ucwaningo lwendawo eselukhona ngohlobo olungenayo lungasazisa izifundo kule nkambu eyinkimbinkimbi.
Izici eziphathelene nomhlabathi ezilawula izinto eziphilayo zomhlabathi nokugcinwa kwe-C emahlathini e-miombo, eZambia
Inhlabathi enomquba (SOM) iyingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwamahlathi kanye nesitoko se-carbon yomhlabathi.
Nokho, kuncane okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhluka kwe-SOM kanye ne-C emahlathini e-miombo okuyisistimu ebalulekile emahlathini ase-sub-Sahara Africa futhi ebalulekile kumasu e-REDD+.

Kulesi sifundo, izici ezilandelayo eziyisishiyagalolunye zalinganiswa futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukwehluka kwe-SOM ezindaweni zamahlathi e-miombo anezakhiwo zezihlahla ezihlukene eLuanshya, eZambia.
Okutholakele kukhombisile ukwehluka okukhulu kwezinqolobane ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene komhlabathi:
36.67 kuya ku-113.89 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni okungu-0–10 cm, 28.67 kuya ku-79.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni okungu-10–20 cm, kanye no-31.89 kuya ku-98.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni okungu-20–30 cm.

Lezi zilinganiso ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene nazo zahluka phakathi kwezindawo zehlathi le-miombo ezinamazinga ahlukene okulandelana, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezithintekile ngokususwa kwezihlahla zakamuva zazinenani le-SOM eliphezulu kunelijwayelekile ngezigaba (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).

Ukuhlaziywa kokuhambisana okujwayelekile (CCA) kwembule ukuthi izici zemvelo ezibaluleke kakhulu ezithinta i-SOM kwakuwukuncipha kwehlathi ngokuhlanza, nokuqukethwe kwesihlabathi ngaphakathi enhlabathini.

Lolu cwaningo lugqamisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukukhombisa ukubaluleka okuhlobene kwezindawo ezihlukene zokulandelana kwehlathi njengomsebenzi wezindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezici zomhlabathi, ekunqumeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM komhlabathi wemiombo.

Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ibalulekile ikakhulukazi ekubhekaneni namasu wamanje e-REDD+ wokuhlumelelisa nokuphatha ahloselwe ukwandisa izitokwe zamakhabhoni emahlathini asendaweni eshisayo e-sub-Saharan Africa.
Sika izihlahla ngokucophelela ukuthuthukisa umhlabathi, kusho ososayensi abafunda amahlathi aseZambia.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo zamahlathi ezihlanzwe kanye nezingaphezulu zomhlabathi ehlathini eZambia zazinezinto eziningi eziphilayo, okusho umhlabathi osezingeni eliphakeme.
Kubalulekile ukuqonda izinga lomhlabathi e-sub-Saharan Africa ngoba linomthelela omkhulu ekutheni izitshalo nezihlahla zikwazi kanjani ukuphila kahle.
Umhlabathi unezakhamzimba ezahlukene, futhi izinto eziphilayo kanye nekhabhoni yizona ezibaluleke kakhulu ukusiza izitshalo zikhule kahle.
Izinto eziphilayo ziyizakhi ezisemhlabathini ezivela ezinsaleni zezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Ngaphezu kwesigamu (58%) sendaba ephilayo yemvelo kumane kuyikhabhoni, kanti okusele kungamanzi nezinye izakhamzimba.
Inhlabathi enezinto eziphilayo eziningi, kanye ne-carbon ngakho-ke, igcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi inezinye izakhamzimba eziningi.
Ososayensi abazi okuningi ngezinguquko ezintweni eziphilayo kanye nekhabhoni enhlabathini yase-sub-Saharan Africa, yize zibaluleke kakhulu ekukhuleni kwezitshalo nezihlahla.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuthola ukuthi izinto eziphilayo ezisemhlabathini ehlathini zishintsha kanjani, nokuthi yini enquma izilinganiso.
Benze ucwaningo lwabo ehlathini eZambia.
Bahlanganisa amasampula omhlabathi phezulu (0-10 cm), maphakathi (10-20 cm), nasejule (20-30 cm), nasezindaweni ezahlukene zehlathi.
Abacwaningi base behlola inhlabathi elebhu ukuze bahlole ukuthi iqukethe malini izinto eziphilayo.
Ilabhorethri iyisakhiwo lapho ososayensi benza khona izivivinyo nezilingo, ngokuvamile besebenzisa imishini enembile ukukala izilinganiso ezithile.
Baphinde baqopha nezinye izakhiwo zomhlabathi njengohlobo lwawo, ngokwesibonelo onothuli noma ofana nodaka.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi inani lezinto eziphilayo belihlukile kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo ezahlukene, nasekujulekeni okuhlukahlukene.
Umhlabathi ongaphezulu wawunezinto eziphilayo eziphakeme kakhulu ezifika ku-114 milligrams (mg) ehektheni, kulandele umhlabathi ojulile (cishe ama-100 mg ngehektha).
Inhlabathi ephakathi yayinenani eliphansi kakhulu lifika ku-80 mg ngehektare.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ehlathini ezisanda kucaciswa zinenqwaba yezinto eziphilayo kunezindawo ezingacacisiwe.
Baphakamisa ukuthi ukusika izihlahla ehlathini, ngokuphathwa ngokucophelela, kungakhuphula inhlabathi enezinto eziphilayo.

Abacwaningi baphinde babona ukuthi umbala womhlabathi ushintshe usuka ebumnyameni obunsundu (umhlabathi ongaphezulu) uye ophuzi onsundu (umhlabathi ojulile), nokuthi izihlabathi kanye nomhlabathi onodaka kwakunezinto eziningi eziphilayo.
Izindawo ehlathini ezazivezwe kakhulu elangeni zazinezihlahla ezinkulu nezindala, kanye nezinto eziphilayo eziningi.
Abacwaningi, ababezinze eZambia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathe izindlela zabo zingaguqulelwa abanye ukuze bahlole izinga lomhlabathi ezindaweni ezihlukene nasekujulenini okuhlukene.
Ukuthuthukisa Ukukhiqizwa Kwe-Chickpea Nokusebenza Kahle Ngokusebenzisa Indlela Yenkundla Yokusungula Yabathintekayo e-Ethiopia
UChickpea (Cicer arietinum L.) uyisithathu ngokubaluleka kwezilimo zokudla ezihamba phambili kokubili endaweni nasekukhiqizeni ngemuva kwamabhontshisi avamile namabhontshisi e-faba e-Ethiopia.
Nokho, ukukhiqizwa kwesitshalo bekuphansi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namandla ngenxa yokungasetshenziswa kwezinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe nobuchwepheshe obuqhamuka ohlelweni locwaningo.

Ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nobuhambisana nocwaningo, iNational Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform yasungulwa ngo-2013 ngenhloso yokuhlanganisa abathintekayo abahlukene abasebenza ohlakeni lwenani ukuze bakhombe izinselelo ezinkulu futhi bathole izixazululo ezizosebenza ngokuhlanganyela.
Ipulatifomu ikhombe ukusweleka kwezimbewu njengesithiyo esikhulu kulesi sigaba.
Le nkinga ibhekwane ngayo ngokusungula izinhlangano zokukhiqiza imbewu zabalimi ngosizo lwabalingani be-R&D futhi njengamanje bayabahlinzeki abakhulu ezweni lonke.
Ngasohlangothini, ipulatifomu yaqinisa umzamo wokwelula futhi yavula ukusakazwa kobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe kubalimi abaningi.
Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhiqiza kwesitshalo ngabalimi abamaphethini kwakhuphuka ngokuphindwe kane futhi ukukhiqiza kwezwe lonke kuphindeke kabili kufinyelela ku-2 ton ha−1 eminyakeni eyishumi edlule.
Iplathifomu iphinde yasebenza ekuthuthukiseni ukufinyelela emakethe futhi muva nje ukhukhunathi uhlanganyele emakethe ye-Ethiopian Commodity Exchange.
Ukwazi amandla amakhulu okuthuthukiswa kwalolu hlobo lwezitshalo, ipulatifomu ilwela ukuqhubeka nokuqinisa ukungenelela nokuvuna amathuba.
Indlela i-Ethiopia eyathuthukisa ngayo ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea

Abacwaningi bachaze ukuthi i-Ethiopia yandisa kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwama-chickpea ngokwenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi banokufinyelela kuzinhlamvu ezithuthukisiwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela ezithuthukisiwe zokulima.
I-Chickpea iyisitshalo sokudla esifana nebhontshisi esivame ukulinywa e-Ethiopia.
Iningi lemikhiqizo yezwe lithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe.
Eminyakeni edlule, abantu abaningi babona ukuthi abalimi bangakhiqiza uhhanyanisi omningi uma besebenzisa imbewu ethuthukisiwe engamelana nezilokazane nezifo.
Incwadi yakamuva ibhala ngokuthi ukukhiqizwa kwe-chickpea e-Ethiopia kwande kanjani kusukela lapho kuqaphelwa.
Ababhali bathi ngo-2013, i-Ethiopia yasungula ‘i-National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform’ eyaxoxa ngezinkinga ekukhiqizeni utshani bese ithola izixazululo.
Ipulatifomu ifana nenhlangano.

Ipulatifomu ibihlanganisa abacwaningi, uMnyango Wezolimo wase-Ethiopia, izinhlangano zamalungu abalimi, izinhlangano ezisebenzisana nabalimi, abacubunguli bokudla, abakhiqizi bezinhlamvu, kanye nabalingani bokuthumela ngaphandle.
Ababhali bathi ipulatifomu yabona ukusweleka kwezimbewu njengenkinga enkulu, kwase kwakhiwa izinhlangano zokuhlinzeka ngezimbewu ezweni lonke.
Lolu shintsho luphinde kabili ukukhiqizwa kukakhukhunathi kufinyelela kumathani angu-2 ngehektare.
Enye inkinga abebeyikhombe kwakuyikhwalithi ephansi yokukhiqiza.
Baqeqeshe abalimi ngezindlela ezingcono zokukhiqiza, ezifana nokusebenzisa umanyolo ukuthuthukisa izinga lomhlabathi.
Babebuye baphawula ukuthi abalimi babenokuhlupheka ukulawula ukhula.

Ngakho-ke banikeze abalimi imbewu yama-chickpea engakhula kahle ngisho noma ifafazwe ngemithi yokubulala ukhula, okuyimikhiqizo yamakhemikhali esetshenziswa abalimi ukulawula ukhula noma izitshalo ezingafuneki.
Ababhali bathi ipulatifomu iqinisekise ukuthi abalimi baqeqeshwe ukuze bandise ulwazi lwabo ekukhiqizeni ama-chickpea.
Abalimi nabo bahambele imicimbi lapho bebengabelana khona ngolwazi kanye nezinto abazihlangenwe nakho.
Ababhali bathi ipulatifomu iphinde yaxhumanisa abalimi nabathengi, nabakhiqizi bezinhlamvu nalabo abaphethe ukuthenga nokusabalalisa izinhlamvu kubalimi.
Iplathifomu iphinde yasungula futhi yaqeqesha izinhlangano zabesifazane nezentsha ekukhiqizeni u-chickpea.
Baqhubeka nokukhuthaza abesifazane nentsha ukuba babambe iqhaza ekukhiqizeni imbewu.
Ababhali bathi naphezu kwezimfanelo ezenziwe, kusenokushoda kwezimbewu ze-chickpea.
Baphinde bathi inkundla ingafeza okuningi uma banezinsiza zokuhlangana njalo.
Bacebise ukuthi uMnyango Wezolimo wase-Ethiopia kanye nabacwaningi kufanele basekele ipulatifomu ngemali ukuze ingawi.
Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yama-chickpea kanye nendlela yokuphathwa kwezingozi zokukhiqiza ama-chickpea, ezifana nezifo.
Ekugcineni, ababhali bacele izimbewu ezithuthukisiwe ezengeziwe ezizoba lula ukuvunwa kusetshenziswa imishini, futhi ezingathinteki ngamakhemikhali okubulala ukhula.
Uhlobo lwe-SARS-CoV-2 lineage A (A.23.1) olune-spike eguquliwe luvele futhi luyalawula ubhadane lwamanje e-Uganda.
Ukuqapha i-genomic ye-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda kunikeza ithuba lokuhlinzeka ngencazelo eqondile yokuguquka kwegciwane ezweni elincane elingaphakathi eMpumalanga Afrika.
Lapha sikhombisa ukuguquka kwakamuva esibhedlela sendawo ngomugqa omusha oqhamukayo u-A.23 oguqukela ku-A.23.1 manje osubusa amacala ase-Uganda futhi ususabalale emazweni angama-26.
Yize izinguquko eziqondile ku-A.23.1 njengoba ijwayele zihlukile kulezo eziguqukayo ezikhathazayo (VOC), ukuvela kukhombisa ukuhlanganisa kusethi efanayo yamaphrotheni.

Isifunda sokufaka ikhodi yephrotheni ye-A.23.1 spike siqongelele izinguquko ezifana nezinguquko eziningi ezibonwa ku-VOC okuhlanganisa ushintsho endaweni engu-613, ushintsho endaweni yokuhlukanisa i-furin eyandisa iphethini ye-amino acid eyisisekelo, kanye nezinguquko eziningi esigabeni se-N-terminal esikhuthaza amasosha omzimba.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, uhlanga lwe-A.23.1 luhlanganisa izinguquko kumaphrotheni angawona ama-spike amanye ama-VOC akhombisa (nsp6, ORF8 kanye ne-ORF9).

Umthelela wezokwelapha wezinhlobo ezihlukene ze-A.23.1 awukacaci okwamanje, nokho kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuhlola ngokucophelela le nguquko, kanye nokuhlola ngokushesha imiphumela yezinguquko zephrotheni ye-spike ekusebenzeni kahle kwemithi yokugoma.
Abacwaningi babika ngoguquko lwezinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda
Ngo-2021, abacwaningi babika ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-SARS-CoV-2, igciwane elibangela i-Covid-19, lwavela e-Uganda lwase lusabalala kwamanye amazwe angama-26.
Baqambe lolu hlobo “A.23.1”, futhi bathi lunoshintsho oluningi olufanayo kumaphrotheni abacwaningi abawabonile kwezinye izinhlobo ezikhathazayo emhlabeni jikelele ngalesi sikhathi.
Ososayensi balandelela ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukene zegciwane le-coronavirus ziguquka kanjani ukuze baqonde kangcono ukuthi imithi yokugoma ingasebenza kahle kangakanani ezinhlotsheni ezintsha.
ICovid-19 ibulale abantu abaningi emhlabeni wonke.
Enqubo eyaziwa ngokuthi ukubhekwa kwe-genomic, ososayensi balandela ukuthi izakhi zofuzo kanye namaphrotheni egciwane zishintsha kanjani njengoba lisakazeka.
Basebenzisa lolu lwazi ukuphatha isifo nokuhola ukuthuthukiswa komuthi wokugoma.
Isibonelo, ngokwazi isakhiwo samaprotheni e-spike egciwane, abacwaningi bangaklama amajova avikela kahle lawo maprotheni ukusiza ukuvimbela igciwane ekungeneni kumaseli abantu.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babheka ngokukhethekile ukuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 yayiguquka kanjani e-Uganda.
Abacwaningi banquma izinhlu zofuzo ze-virus emasampuleni e-COVID-19 positive aqoqwe kulo lonke elase-Uganda.

Basebenzisa isofthiwe yekhompyutha ukuze balandele ulayini (noma umlando womndeni) wezinhlobo ezintsha abazikhombe ngale ndlela (ebizwa ngokuthi A.23.1), futhi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi le nguqulo ifanelana kuphi esihlahleni somndeni we-SARS-CoV-2.
Imiphumela yabo yabonisa ukuthi i-A.23.1 ehlukile isanda kuvela kwenye ehlukile ebizwa ngokuthi i-A.23, futhi yatholakala ku-90% wazo zonke izampula ezinhle.
Ngamanye amazwi, ibikade ilawula amasampula ase-Uganda kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2020.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lwalunezinguquko eziningana ku-phrotheni ye-spike ezifanayo nezinye izinguquko ezibonwa kwezinye izinhlobo ezikhathaza.
Izinguquko kungenzeka zenza uhlobo lube nokudluliselwa kalula (lusabalala ngokushesha), futhi lube nokumelana kakhulu nemithi yokugoma kanye nokwelashwa.
Lolu cwaningo lufaka isandla emizamweni eqhubekayo yokuqopha izinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni jikelele.
Imiphumela ingeza kubufakazi obukhulayo bokuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 ivela ngokushesha njengoba isakazeka ukuze ithelele abantu abaningi futhi igweme amajova.
Nokho, kudingeka olunye ucwaningo ukuze kuqondwe ukuthi yimaphi ngempela imiphumela noma imisebenzi yezinguquko zephrotheni ye-spike kuhlobo lwe-A.23.1.
Abacwaningi batusa ukuqapha okwengeziwe kwe-genomic ukusisiza ukuqonda ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlukene zegciwane ziphendula kanjani kumagciwane atholakala e-Uganda nakwamanye amazwe.
Baphinde bathi ukuqapha ukuhamba kwamazwe ngamazwe kubalulekile ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuqonda kangcono ukuthi igciwane lisakazeka kanjani endaweni.
Yini Eyenza Owesifazane?
Izifundo Zamacala Ezibhalisa Izizathu Nezimo Zokuhlinzwa/Ukusikwa Kwezitho Zobulili Kwabesifazane e-Indonesia, e-Ethiopia nase-Kenya
Ukusoka/ukugwazwa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane kuyisiko eliyingozi eliphula amalungelo abesifazane futhi linezinto ezimbi ezithinta impilo.
Leli phepha liletha izizathu nezimo zokuhlinzwa/ ukusikwa kwezitho zangasese zabesifazane (FGM/C) ezindaweni ezithile zamazwe amathathu – i-Indonesia, i-Ethiopia kanye ne-Kenya.

Idatha yaqoqwa ngocwaningo lwasekhaya nabantu abasha (iminyaka engu-15-24) nangezingxoxo zamaqembu agxile, izingxoxo ezijulile kanye nezingxoxo nabantu ababalulekile nentsha kanye nabathintekayo emphakathini ngo-2016 nango-2017.
Izibalo ezichazayo kanye nokuhlaziywa kokuqukethwe kwendikimba kwenziwe.
Okutholakele kocwaningo kuqinisekisa ezinye zezizathu ze-FGM/C ezibhalwe ezincwadini zangaphambilini, kuphawulwa ukuthi lezi zizathu zihlobene kakhulu, futhi izindlela zobulili ziyimbangela ephansi.
Kuzo zonke izilungiselelo ezintathu, lezi zizathu ziqhuba izinguquko emizimbeni yabesifazane ukuze kuphumelele umzimba 'owenhlonipho' ovumelana nesimo sobuzwe esibusa amadoda.
Lokhu kuholela ku-‘mzimba ohlanzekile’ e-Indonesia, ‘mzimba othambile’ e-Ethiopia kanye ‘nomzimba womuntu omdala’ eKenya.
Izisebenzi zezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C kuzo zonke izindawo.
ENyakatho neKenya, ikakhulukazi, izintombi ezisakhulayo zixoxisana ngendima yazo ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana ne-FGM/C njengoba sebekhulile ngesikhathi sokusoka.

Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimo zomthetho nezenhlalo eziguqukayo endaweni ngayinye ziletha izinguquko esikweni le-FGM/C okuba nomthelela ekwenzeni i-FGM/C ibe yinto yezokwelapha e-Indonesia, ukwehla kweminyaka yokusoka kwentombazane e-Kenya kanye nokwanda kokwenziwa kwe-FGM/C ngokufihlekile e-Ethiopia.
Amacala amathathu akhombisa umehluko omkhulu ekwenzeni i-FGM/C kanye nencazelo yezenhlalo enikezwa yizintokazi kanye nemiphakathi yazo.
Kukhona isidingo sokuhlola kabanzi indima yabazali ekwenzeni izinqumo.

Ngenxa yokuxhumana phakathi kwababangela abahlukene be-FGM/C ngaphakathi komongo ngamunye, ucwaningo luphetha ngokuthi izindlela ezithile zomongo zidinga ukwamukelwa izinyathelo zokungenelela ukuze kudaleke ushintsho oluhlala isikhathi eside.
Ukuze siyeke ukusoka abesifazane, sidinga ukuqonda ukuthi kungani kwenzeka lokhu kuqala.

Ukusoka izitho zangasese zabesifazane, okuyisenzo lapho izingxenye zezitho zangasese zabesifazane zisikwa noma zisuswa, kusenzeka ngokungekho emthethweni noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, i-Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.
Abacwaningi bathi ukuqonda ukuthi kungani kwenzeka kuyisihluthulelo sokumisa lo mkhuba onobungozi, nokuvimbela izinkinga zezempilo nezengqondo abesifazane abahlupheka ngazo ngenxa yalokhu.
Ezingxenyeni zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukusoka abesifazane, okwezinye izikhathi okubizwa ngokuthi 'ukusoka kwabesifazane', kusasetshenziswa kakhulu.

Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngokungamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kuhlanzwe kahle noma ukugcina abesifazane benesizotha (bengenakho ukuzikhukhumeza futhi bezithobile), futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuba nezingane.
I-FGM ayidingeki nganoma yikuphi kwalokhu ngokusho kobufakazi besayensi.
Ezimweni eziningi, nokho, izingane ezibhekene ne-FGM zigcina zinezinkinga zezempilo kamuva empilweni, njengokutheleleka okuyingozi, ubunzima bokuchama, nezinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Ngoba lo mkhuba uyingozi kangaka futhi wephula amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi awenze waba ngumthetho ukuwuvimbela, kodwa abantu basawenza ngasese.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda kabanzi ukuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi abantu bakholelwa ini mayelana nalesi senzo.
Ngakho-ke baqoqa ulwazi mayelana ne-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.

Ezweni ngalinye, abacwaningi bakhuluma nabantu mayelana nalomkhuba, kubandakanya abazali, abantu abasha, abaholi bendabuko, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye nabasiki’bendlebe’ (abesifazane abadala ababejwayele ukwenza i-FGM kumantombazane amancane).
Kwezinye izimo, babaxoxela laba bantu ngabanye, kodwa baphinde bakhuluma namaqembu abantu, okuhlanganisa nabantu abadala abasebasha kanye nezinsizwa, ababehlushwe i-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu ze-FGM, indlela eyenziwa ngayo, kanye nezinkolelo mayelana nale nkambiso, zazihlukile ezweni ngalinye.
Futhi bathole ukuthi abantu abaningi basayenza, ngisho nasezindaweni lapho kwakungekho emthethweni.

Isibonelo, e-Indonesia, abezokubelethisa bendabuko basebenzisa ummese noma inaliti ukusika ingxenye ye-clitoris (ithambo eliyinhloko elibhekelele injabulo yezocansi kwabesifazane) uma usana lwentombazane luneminyaka engu-40 yezinsuku.
Abantu bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusiza ‘ukususa ukungcola’ futhi kwakubalulekile ngezizathu zenkolo.
Ethiopia, ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenzeka ngisho nakusasele, kwesinye isikhathi uma izingane zisanda kuzalwa zineminyaka engu-7 kuphela.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abantu lapho bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzokuqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izoba 'unkosikazi omuhle' ngelinye ilanga, futhi izothembeka, ingabi nodlame kumyeni wayo.
Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenza kube lula ukuzala kodwa empeleni kungase kwenze kube nzima ukuzala.
Khonamanjalo eKenya, i-FGM yayibonisa ukuthi intombazane isifinyelele ebudaleni, futhi ngokuvamile yayenzeka kamuva empilweni, ngesikhathi eseyintombazane esakhula.

Kwezinye izimo, nokho, bathola ukuthi amantombazane angahlinzwa i-FGM esemncane njengeminyaka engu-8, futhi amantombazane amaningi agcina ekhulelwe esemancane, ngoba abhekwa njengabakhulile ngokwanele ocansini ngemuva kwe-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathi okutholakele kwabo kukhombisa ukuthi kunezizathu eziningi ezahlukene zokuthi i-FGM isenzeka namanje.
Njengoba imithetho nemibono yomphakathi ishintsha, indlela nendawo lapho kwenziwa khona nako kuyashintsha.
Isibonelo, abazali bangazama ukukwenza ngasese nakuba kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuze indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.

Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi ukusoka abesifazane akuvumelekile kwezinye izindawo, ucwaningo ngalolu daba lungaba lukhuni, futhi abantu bangase bangahlali benikeza izimpendulo eziyiqiniso ngalesi sihloko.

Esikhathini esizayo, ngaphezu kokukwenza kungemthetho, abacwaningi bathi ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele bazame ukumisa ukusoka ngokubhekana nezinkolelo ezingamanga abantu abanazo ngalolu hlelo nokubafundisa ngobungozi balo.

Lolu cwaningo bekuyisebenzisana phakathi kososayensi abavela e-Ethiopia, Indonesia naseNetherlands, futhi luyingxenye yephrojekthi enkulu ebizwa ngokuthi ‘Yes I Do programme’, ehlose ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwentsha, umshado wezingane kanye ne-FGM.

Ukungalingani KwamaHormone Okuzala, Ukuwohloka Kwamaseli Ezinto Zokuzala, Ukungajwayelekile Kwezinhlobo ZeSperm Morphophenotypes kanye Nezinguquko Ze-Ultrastructural Ku-Testis Yezilwane Ezinkulu Zase-Afrika (Cricetomys gambianus, Waterhouse, 1840) Ezivezwe Ekudakweni Yi-Sodium Metavanadate.
Ukuchayeka kwemvelo ku-vanadium kuye kwanda muva nje.
Leli insimbi yaziwa njengeyingozi.
Ucwaningo lwamanje lwenziwe ukuze kuhlolwe ubuthi bokuzala be-sodium metavanadate (SMV) kumagundane amakhulu ase-Afrika abesilisa.
Ukuphathwa kwe-SMV kwenziwa ngaphakathi kwe-peritoneal nsuku zonke izinsuku eziyi-14 zilandelana ngomthamo ongu-3mg/kg wesisindo somzimba.
Amanzi angenazinto eziphilayo anikezwe iqembu lokulawula.
Sihlaziye amahomoni okuzala egazini, isitoreji nesimo sefagazi kanye nezinguquko zesakhiwo samasende ngemva kokwelashwa kwe-SMV.
Imiphumela yethu ikhombise ukuthi iqembu le-AGR elivezwe ku-SMV line-progesterone eyandisiwe ngokwezibalo kodwa izinga le-testosterone, i-FSH kanye ne-LH lehle.

Ngaphezu kwalokho, iqembu eliphathwe nge-SMV libe nokwehla okubalulekile kwezibalo ekunyakazeni kwesidoda kanye nomsebenzi omningi ngokukhuphuka iphesenti lama-morphophenotypes angajwayelekile esidoda kanye nokwenyuka kokuphakama kwamangqamuzana e-P53 immunopositive.
Ucwaningo lwe-ultrastructural luveze ukuvuvukala kwamaseli ezinto zokuzala nama-Sertoli, i-cytoplasmic kanye ne-nucleus; futhi kwaphawulwa ukuvuvukala kwe-mitochondria kanye nokuvuvukala.
Kube nokuhlukana okukhulu kwama-seminiferous tubules, ukuwohloka nokonakala kwamaseli e-myeloid kanye ne-apoptosis yamaseli e-Leydig, Sertoli kanye namaseli ezinsalela.

Ekugcineni, ukuvezwa kwe-SMV ngaphakathi kwe-peritoneal kubangela imiphumela emibi kakhulu kwamanye amahomoni okuzala egazini, ukuncipha kwesibalo kanye nekhwalithi yesidoda, i-apoptosis kanye nezinguquko ezigugayo zamaLeydig, Sertoli kanye nezicubu zokuzala ezingaholela ekungazaleni.
Abacwaningi bathi insimbi etholakala emoyeni ongcolile yenza amagundane angabi nenzalo.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-vanadium, uhlobo lwensimbi, ilimaza amaseli amagundane kanye nekhono lawo lokudala inzalo (ukuzala).

Ngoba le nsimbi iphinde ibe yingozi kubantu, baphakamisa ukuthi kwenziwe olunye ucwaningo ukuthola ukuthi le nsimbi, etholakala ngokwanda endaweni yethu ngenxa yokungcoliswa, ingase ibe nemiphumela emibi efanayo empilweni yabantu.
Nakuba i-vanadium iyinsimbi, ingangena emoyeni ngamanani amancane lapho kushiswa amafutha ezinto eziphilayo, njengamafutha kawoyela namalahle.
Njengoba umhlaba usebenzisa lezi zinsiza zamafutha ngokwengeziwe, inani lokungcoliswa kwe-vanadium liyanda.
Sesivele siyazi ukuthi abantu abavezwe kukho bangahlushwa izinkinga zezempilo ezifana nokushoda kwegazi, izihlathi ezomile namehlo, kanye nobuhlungu besifuba.
Muva nje, ososayensi nabo sebeqala ukuthakasela imiphumela i-vanadium engaba nayo ekuzaleni.
Sebeqalile ukufunda le miphumela emabunzini, ahlale esetshenziswa elebhu ngenxa yokufana kwawo nabantu.
Kulesi sifundo, ososayensi babenentshisekelo emiphumeleni ye-vanadium ohlotsheni oluvamile lwegundane elitholakala eNtshonalanga Afrika, elibizwa nge-African Giant Rat.
Babefuna ukuqonda ukuthi i-vanadium ishintsha kanjani izinhlelo zokuzala zamaduna amagundane, ikakhulukazi isidoda sawo, amahomoni, kanye namaseli ezidoda zawo.
Abacwaningi bafaka amajovo e-vanadium kumagundane ayizinsikazi ayisithupha kanye ngosuku, izinsuku eziyi-14.
Ngasikhathi sinye, bafaka amanye amagundane ayi-6 ngamanzi njengokuhlolwa "kokulawula".
Ngoba amanzi bekungeke kube lula ukuthinta amagundane, abacwaningi babengaqiniseka ukuthi noma yikuphi ukuguquka abakubonayo kumagundane ayisithupha okuqala kwakuwumphumela wemijovo ye-vanadium.
Ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-14, bahlola ukuthi inani lamahomoni, njenge-testosterone, lishintshile yini, futhi bahlola izindlala zabo zesidoda futhi babala isidoda sabo.

Sebenzisa indlela ebizwa nge-Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), bakwazile ukubona noma yiziphi izinguquko ezenzeka ezithweni zokuzala ngokuningiliziwe, kuze kufike ezingeni lamangqamuzana ngamanye.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amagundane afakelwe i-vanadium abe nezinga eliphansi kakhulu le-testosterone, nezinye amahomoni abalulekile ekuzaleni.
Amagundane afakelwe i-vanadium nawo abe nenani elincane kakhulu le-sperms, kanti nesperms yawo ibingaphilile kangako.
Abacwaningi babona, isibonelo, ukuthi ezinye zezidoda zamagundane zazingenakhanda noma zinomsila ogobile, futhi zazingenakunyakaza kangako uma kuqhathaniswa nezidoda zamagundane afakelwe amanzi.

Ngoba isidoda yizicubu zobulili zezinhlobonhlobo zesilisa, ezisetshenziselwa ukuvundisa amaqanda kwabesifazane, lezi zinguquko zingenza kube nzima kakhulu ukuthi amagundane akwazi ukuzalana ngempumelelo.
Ekugcineni, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ezinye zezicubu ezisuka ezindebeni zamathole zazilimale kabi noma zabhujiswa yi-vanadium.
Abacwaningi bathe izinguquko abazitholile ekugcineni zingadala ukungabi namandla okuveza inzalo ngokuphelele.
Baqaphele ukuthi njengoba izilwane ezivezwa ku-vanadium nakwezinye izigcwalisi zemvelo zingase zingakwazi ukuzala, kungenzeka ziphele ngenxa yalezi zinto.
Ngoba abantu bayizilwane ezincelisayo njengezimpuku, ososayensi kufanele baphinde bafunde noma yiziphi izimpembelelo ezingezinhle ezingaba khona ze-vanadium ezindaweni ezingcolile empilweni yabantu.

Abacwaningi baxwayise ukuthi ezinye zezinguquko abazitholile ekwakhekeni kwezilwane nasehomonini zazingafani nalokho okutholwe ezifundweni zesayensi zangaphambilini, ngakho kudingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe umonakalo obangelwa i-vanadium.

Lolu cwaningo bekuyisebenzisana phakathi kososayensi abavela eNigeria naseGibhithe, futhi kungeza kulokho ososayensi abakuziyo ngokuthi izilwane, futhi mhlawumbe nabantu, bathinteka kanjani ukungcoliswa.
Ukusetshenziswa Kwezamasiko Kwezitshalo Zasekhaya Emphakathini Wabomdabu ENyakatho Ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia
Ukwakheka kwezimbali ezindaweni zokuhlala eNyakatho-ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia ngokujwayelekile, kanye nesifunda saseGozamin ikakhulukazi, kuthole ukunakwa okuncane ocwaningweni.
Inhloso yalolu cwaningo iwukuqonda kangcono ukwakheka kwezitshalo kanye nokubaluleka kwamasiko ezivandeni zasekhaya.
Inqubo yokukhetha amasampula ngokungahleliwe enezigaba isetshenziswe ngokusekelwe ekwehlukaneni kwe-agroecological kuma-kebeles akhethiwe.

Idatha yengadi yasekhaya yaqoqwa ngokuhlukanisa ingadi yasekhaya yaba ama-quadrat amane, i-quadrat yokuqala yasuka ekhaya lomlimi yaya ku-10m, i-quadrat yesibili kusuka ku-10m kuya ku-20m, i-quadrat yesithathu kusuka ku-20m kuya ku-30m kanti i-quadrat yesine kusuka ku-30m kuya ku-40m ngokuvundlile kusetshenziswa ikhaya lomlimi njengesethenjwa kuye ngosayizi wengadi.
Inhlolokhono eyakhiwe ngokwengxenye yenziwe ukubhala phansi ulwazi lomuntu onolwazi ngohlobo lwezitshalo.
Sekukonke izinhlobo zezimbali ezibalulekile ngokwesiko ezingama-238 ezivela emindenini engu-81 zikhonjwe.
Kulezi, u-39% kwakuyizitshalo zemithi, u-29% izihlahla, u-6% kwakuyizikhuphukeli.
Izitshalo ezihlala unyaka wonke zakha ingxenye enkulu yezinhlobo ezilinywayo (83%), kanti ezinyangeni ezingama-12 zakha okusele (17%).
Umndeni we-Poaceae wawunezinhlobo eziphambili, ezinama-22, kulandele i-Fabaceae, enama-21, ne-Asteraceae enama-15.

Kulezi zitshalo ezirekhodiwe, u-140 (58.6%) bekungamazinga asetshenziswa ezindaweni zemvelo, u-84 (35%) izitshalo zokudla, u-83 (34.7%) izinhlobo zezinto zokwelapha, u-39 (16.3%) izinzalo zokudla kwezilwane, u-57 (23.8%) izitshalo zokusetshenziswa kwezinto, u-60 (25%) izinzalo zokhuni lwezibaso, u-50 (21%) izitshalo zokusetshenziswa kwezenhlalo futhi u-1 (0.4%) unobuthi.
Ukuhlolwa okuqondile kwe-matrix kwembula ukuthi i-Cordia Africana itholakale iyisitshalo esibalulekile ngokwezamasiko endaweni futhi esisengozini enkulu, kulandelwa i-Ficus sur.
Inani lokusetshenziswa eliphakeme kakhulu le-Cordia africana belingokwakha kanti inani lohlu belingelezokwelapha.
Inkomba yokufana ye-Sorensen yamaphesenti angama-64 ezindawo ezihloliwe yayincane kuno-0.5.
Umphumela ukhombisile ukuthi izivande zasekhaya ziyizinhlelo zokukhiqiza ezinemisebenzi eminingi, zesikhathi eside.
Ukuphepha kokudla kanye nokongiwa kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinto eziphilayo kuqhubeka nokuxhaswa ulwazi lwamasiko lwabantu bendabuko oluxhumene nezivande zabo zasekhaya.

Ukufana okuncane/ukuhlukahluka okuphezulu kwezinhlobo endaweni phakathi kwamakhebula kukhombisile ukuthi bekukhona ukuhlukahluka okuphezulu kwezinhlobo lokhu bekubangelwa izimo ezihlukahlukene ze-agroecological phakathi kwamakhebula.
Amagadi ase-Ethiopia asekelwa ukuphepha kokudla nokongiwa kwemvelo.
Abacwaningi bathi abantu abaningi base-Ethiopia batshala ukudla, izitshalo zokuhlobisa, izitshalo zemithi nezitshalo zokudla kwezilwane, umthunzi noma uthango ezivandeni zabo.
Bahlaziye lezi zingadi ukuze babone ukuthi zibaluleke kangakanani ekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla nokusiza ukugcina imvelo.
Imiphakathi emhlabeni wonke igcina izingadi zokudla, ukwenza imali kanye nezinye izinhloso zamasiko.
Izivande zibuye zivikele izitshalo ezibalulekile ezivame ukuba zikhona noma zinyamalale kwezinye izindawo.
ENyakatho ye-Ethiopia, akwenziwa ucwaningo oluningi ngqo lokuthi imiphakathi itshalani ezivandeni zabo.
Kulesi sicwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuphenya izitshalo abantu abaseGozamin esifundeni, enyakatho-ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia, abazikhulisayo ezivandeni zabo kanye nalokho abazisebenzisela khona.
Bahlonza futhi babala izitshalo ezingadini eziyi-357 endaweni.
Babuye baxoxisana nomphakathi mayelana nalokho abasebenzisa izitshalo kukho.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi zonke izivande eGozamin bezingaphansi kwehektha ngobukhulu.
Baqoqa futhi bakhombe izitshalo ezihlukene ezingu-238.
Iningi (83%) lezitshalo lalikhuliswa unyaka wonke, kanti ezimbalwa kuphela (17%) ezazingezesikhathi esithile.
Imiphumela yabo yabonisa ukuthi umphakathi wawusebenzisa izitshalo ukudla, imithi, ukwakha, ukudla kwezilwane, kanye nezinye izindlela zamasiko.
Izitshalo eziningi zisebenze izinjongo ezingaphezu kweyodwa.
Isibonelo, isihlahla esikhulu esinezimpande ezinkulu saseNyakatho singasetshenziswa emithini, ekuhlobiseni, ekudleni kwezilwane, ekunikezeni umthunzi, ekuvinjeni nasezinye izindlela zesiko.
Ngaphezu kwengxenye (59%) yezitshalo zazisetshenziswa ngezinhloso zemvelo ezifana nokubiyela, izihlahla ezincane, umthunzi kanye nokuhlobisa.
Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kusize ukuvikela imvelo.
Ukufaka izitshalo zokuvikela nakho kusize ekuvikeleni imikhiqizo yezolimo.
Kancane ngaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (35%) yezitshalo zavunwa ukudla, njengokuthi izithelo, imifino, okusanhlamvu kanye nezithako zokunambitha.
Bathi nokho izivande endaweni ziningi zinikeza izithelo.

Abacwaningi bathi u-35% wezitshalo zazisetshenziswa njengemithi yendabuko yokuphila kahle kwabantu nezilwane, kanti u-21% zazisetshenziswa ezinkambisweni nasezinhlosweni zokukhonza, ukubhema, amakha nokubhaka.
Ezinye izitshalo (17%) zazisetshenziswa njengokudla kwezinkomo, izimvu, nezimbongolo.
Abanye (24%) basebenza njengempahla yokwakha, ukwenza amathuluzi engadi, ukufulela uphahla nokwenza izintambo.
Njengoba iningi labantu basemakhaya kubikwa ukuthi basebenzisa izinkuni, u-25% wezitshalo zazisetshenziswa ngalokho.
Abacwaningi bathi isitshalo esisodwa kuphela (0.4%) esashiwoyo ngenhloso yokubulala.
Baphinde bathi indlela izitshalo ezazihlelwe ngayo endaweni yayithonywa imvelo, lokho abantu abathanda ukukudla, kanye nesimo sezimali somndeni nezidingo zebhizinisi.
Isibonelo, indawo ebizwa ngokuthi i-Wenka eyayinenzi yokunisela futhi eseduze nedolobha elikhulu, yayinezindawo eziningi zokulima futhi yaqopha izitshalo ezihlukene eziyi-130.
Abantu bakwaWenka baphinde bakhulisa futhi bahlinzeka izithelo nemifino emakethe yedolobha.
Okokugcina, abacwaningi bathi abalimi abaningi bakhetha ukutshala izitshalo ezinamasebenziswano amaningi.
Abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yabo iqinisekisile ukuthi impela abalimi batshala izinhlobo eziningi ezahlukene zezitshalo ezingadini zabo, futhi ngezindlela ezahlukene zokusetshenziswa.
Yize laba abacwaningi bethole ukuthi abalimi abaningi batshala amakhambi, abanye abacwaningi babethi izihlahla zazivame kakhulu endaweni.
Abacwaningi balesi sifundo bebesisekelwe emanyuvesi ase-Ethiopia.
